    "src/core/minifier.ts": {
      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "collectAllNodes",
          "line": 8,

          "isExported": false,

          "returnType": "any[]",
          "calls": [

          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const allNodes: any[] = [];\n  const visited = new Set<any>();\n\n  function traverse(node: any) {\n    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object' || visited.has(node)) return;\n    visited.add(node);\n    allNodes.push(node);\n\n    // Обходим все свойства узла рекурсивно\n    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n      const value = node[key];\n      if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n        for (const item of value) {\n          if (item && typeof item === 'object') {\n            traverse(item);\n          }\n        }\n      } else if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !(value instanceof RegExp)) {\n        // Пропускаем RegExp и другие специальные объекты\n        try {\n          traverse(value);\n        } catch (e) {\n          // Игнорируем ошибки\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  traverse(ast);\n  return allNodes;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!ast) {\n    console.warn('⚠️ AST is null, returning original code');\n    return code;\n  }\n\n  const cuts: { start: number; end: number; replaceWith: string }[] = [];\n\n  // Собираем все узлы рекурсивно\n  const allNodes = collectAllNodes(ast);\n  console.log(`📊 Собрано узлов для обработки: ${allNodes.length}`);\n\n  for (const node of allNodes) {\n    // Замена тел функций и методов (включая FunctionExpression)\n    if (\n      (node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' ||\n        node.type === 'FunctionExpression' ||\n        node.type === 'MethodDefinition' ||\n        node.type === 'ClassMethod') &&\n      node.body &&\n      node.body.range\n    ) {\n      const bodyStart = node.body.range[0];\n      const bodyEnd = node.body.range[1];\n\n      if (bodyStart < bodyEnd && bodyEnd - bodyStart > 2) {\n        cuts.push({\n          start: bodyStart + 1,\n          end: bodyEnd - 1,\n          replaceWith: ' /* реализация скрыта */ ',\n        });\n        const nodeName = node.key?.name || node.id?.name || 'anonymous';\n        console.log(`   ✂️ Найдена функция/метод: ${nodeName}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Замена тел стрелочных функций\n    if (\n      node.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' &&\n      node.body &&\n      node.body.type === 'BlockStatement' &&\n      node.body.range\n    ) {\n      const bodyStart = node.body.range[0];\n      const bodyEnd = node.body.range[1];\n\n      if (bodyStart < bodyEnd && bodyEnd - bodyStart > 2) {\n        cuts.push({\n          start: bodyStart + 1,\n          end: bodyEnd - 1,\n          replaceWith: ' /* реализация скрыта */ ',\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Замена значений переменных\n    if (\n      node.type === 'VariableDeclarator' &&\n      node.init &&\n      !['ArrowFunctionExpression', 'FunctionExpression'].includes(node.init.type) &&\n      node.init.range\n    ) {\n      if (!shouldPreserveValue(node)) {\n        cuts.push({\n          start: node.init.range[0],\n          end: node.init.range[1],\n          replaceWith: '/* значение скрыто */',\n        });\n        console.log(`   🔒 Переменная: ${node.id?.name} → значение скрыто`);\n      } else {\n        console.log(`   ✅ Сохранена переменная: ${node.id?.name}`);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Применяем замены от конца к началу\n  cuts.sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start);\n  let minifiedCode = code;\n\n  for (const cut of cuts) {\n    minifiedCode = minifiedCode.slice(0, cut.start) + cut.replaceWith + minifiedCode.slice(cut.end);\n  }\n\n  console.log(`📊 Выполнено замен: ${cuts.length}`);\n\n  // Очистка лишних пустых строк\n  return minifiedCode.replace(/^\\s*[\\r\\n]/gm, '\\n').replace(/\\n{3,}/g, '\\n\\n');\n}",

          "isMethod": false,

          "name": "shouldPreserveValue",

          "isExported": false,

          "returnType": "boolean",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  if (!node.init || !node.id || !node.id.name) return false;\n\n  const varName = node.id.name;\n  const initNode = node.init;\n\n  // Сохраняем конфигурационные переменные (UPPER_CASE)\n  const preservePatterns = [\n    /^[A-Z][A-Z_]+$/, // UPPER_CASE - конфигурационные константы\n    /PATTERNS$/,\n    /SELECTORS$/,\n    /CONFIG$/,\n    /SETTINGS$/,\n    /OPTIONS$/,\n    /_CONFIG$/,\n    /_SETTINGS$/,\n    /_OPTIONS$/,\n    /^pageContext$/,\n    /^lastPageState$/,\n    /^syncScheduled$/,\n  ];\n\n  for (const pattern of preservePatterns) {\n    if (pattern.test(varName)) {\n      return true;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Сохраняем регулярные выражения\n  if (initNode.type === 'RegExpLiteral') {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // Сохраняем массивы с селекторами или паттернами\n  if (initNode.type === 'ArrayExpression' && initNode.elements) {\n    for (const element of initNode.elements) {\n      if (!element) continue;\n      if (element.type === 'RegExpLiteral') return true;\n      if (element.type === 'Literal' && typeof element.value === 'string') {\n        const strValue = element.value;\n        if (\n          strValue.startsWith('#') ||\n          strValue.startsWith('.') ||\n          strValue.startsWith('[') ||\n          strValue.includes('selector') ||\n          strValue.includes('pattern')\n        ) {\n          return true;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Сохраняем примитивные значения (строки, числа, булевы)\n  if (initNode.type === 'Literal') {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}",

    "src/core/graph-utils.ts": {
      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "findCyclicEdges",
          "line": 8,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graph"
          ],
          "returnType": "Set<string>",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const visited: Record<string, number> = {};\n  const cyclicEdges = new Set<string>();\n  const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n\n  // Инициализация статусов: 0 - не посещен, 1 - в процессе, 2 - обработан\n  Object.keys(graph).forEach(node => {\n    visited[node] = 0;\n  });\n\n  function dfs(node: string, path: string[] = []): void {\n    visited[node] = 1; // В процессе обхода\n    recursionStack.add(node);\n    path.push(node);\n\n    const neighbors = graph[node] || [];\n\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      if (recursionStack.has(neighbor)) {\n        // Найден цикл: отмечаем все ребра в цикле\n        const cycleStartIndex = path.indexOf(neighbor);\n        if (cycleStartIndex !== -1) {\n          for (let i = cycleStartIndex; i < path.length; i++) {\n            const from = path[i];\n            const to = i + 1 < path.length ? path[i + 1] : neighbor;\n            cyclicEdges.add(`${from}->${to}`);\n          }\n        }\n        cyclicEdges.add(`${node}->${neighbor}`);\n      } else if (visited[neighbor] === 0) {\n        dfs(neighbor, [...path]);\n      }\n    }\n\n    recursionStack.delete(node);\n    visited[node] = 2; // Обработан\n  }\n\n  // Запускаем DFS для всех непосещенных узлов\n  Object.keys(graph).forEach(node => {\n    if (visited[node] === 0) dfs(node, []);\n  });\n\n  return cyclicEdges;\n}",

          "endLine": 52,

        {
          "name": "convertToDOT",
          "line": 60,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData",

          ],
          "returnType": "string",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const { rootKey, graph } = graphData;\n\n  let dot = 'digraph \"Dependency Graph\" {\\n';\n  dot += '  rankdir=LR;\\n';\n  dot += '  splines=true;\\n';\n  dot +=\n    '  node [shape=box, style=\"filled,rounded\", color=\"#4f46e5\", fontname=\"Arial\", fillcolor=\"#f3f4f6\", fontcolor=\"#1f2937\", penwidth=1];\\n';\n  dot += '  edge [color=\"#9ca3af\", arrowhead=vee, penwidth=1];\\n';\n\n  // Корневой узел выделяем звездочкой\n  dot += `  \"${rootKey}\" [fillcolor=\"#4f46e5\", fontcolor=\"#ffffff\", penwidth=2, label=\"⭐ ${rootKey}\"];\\n`;\n\n  // Добавляем все ребра\n  Object.keys(graph).forEach(node => {\n    const nodeDeps = graph[node];\n    if (nodeDeps) {\n      nodeDeps.forEach(dep => {\n        const edgeKey = `${node}->${dep}`;\n        if (cyclicEdges.has(edgeKey)) {\n          // Подсвечиваем циклические зависимости красным\n          dot += `  \"${node}\" -> \"${dep}\" [color=\"#ef4444\", penwidth=2.5, style=\"dashed\", label=\"цикл\"];\\n`;\n        } else {\n          dot += `  \"${node}\" -> \"${dep}\";\\n`;\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  dot += '}\\n';\n  return dot;\n}",
          "startLine": 60,
          "endLine": 94,
          "isMethod": false,

          "body": "{\n  // Если указан явный путь, используем его\n  if (explicitTsConfigPath) {\n    const resolvedPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), explicitTsConfigPath);\n    const normalizedPath = normalizePathForOS(resolvedPath);\n\n    if (fs.existsSync(normalizedPath)) {\n      try {\n        const content = fs.readFileSync(normalizedPath, 'utf-8');\n        console.log(`📄 Загружен tsconfig: ${normalizedPath}`);\n        cachedTsConfig = JSON.parse(content) as TsConfig;\n        cachedTsConfigDir = path.dirname(normalizedPath);\n        return cachedTsConfig;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибка парсинга ${normalizedPath}:`, error);\n      }\n    } else {\n      console.warn(`⚠️ Файл tsconfig не найден: ${normalizedPath}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Иначе ищем автоматически\n  let currentDir = startDir;\n  const root = path.parse(currentDir).root;\n\n  while (currentDir !== root) {\n    const tsConfigPath = path.join(currentDir, 'tsconfig.json');\n    const normalizedTsConfigPath = normalizePathForOS(tsConfigPath);\n\n    if (fs.existsSync(normalizedTsConfigPath)) {\n      try {\n        const content = fs.readFileSync(normalizedTsConfigPath, 'utf-8');\n        cachedTsConfig = JSON.parse(content) as TsConfig;\n        cachedTsConfigDir = path.dirname(normalizedTsConfigPath);\n        console.log(`📄 Автоматически загружен tsconfig: ${normalizedTsConfigPath}`);\n        return cachedTsConfig;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибка парсинга ${normalizedTsConfigPath}:`, error);\n      }\n    }\n    currentDir = path.dirname(currentDir);\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}",

          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  if (!tsConfig?.compilerOptions?.paths) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  const { paths, baseUrl = '.' } = tsConfig.compilerOptions;\n  const baseUrlPath = path.resolve(baseDir, baseUrl);\n\n  for (const [alias, targets] of Object.entries(paths)) {\n    if (!targets || targets.length === 0) continue;\n\n    // Преобразуем паттерн алиаса в регулярное выражение\n    const escapedAlias = alias.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\\\$&');\n    const pattern = escapedAlias.replace(/\\\\\\*/g, '(.*)');\n    const regex = new RegExp(`^${pattern}$`);\n    const match = importPath.match(regex);\n\n    if (match) {\n      // Берём первый целевой путь\n      let targetPath = targets[0];\n      if (!targetPath) continue;\n\n      // Заменяем * на захваченные группы\n      for (let i = 1; i < match.length; i++) {\n        const replacement = match[i];\n        if (replacement !== undefined) {\n          targetPath = targetPath.replace('*', replacement);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Резолвим относительно baseUrl\n      const resolvedPath = path.resolve(baseUrlPath, targetPath);\n      const normalizedResolvedPath = normalizePathForOS(resolvedPath);\n\n      // Проверяем существование файла с разными расширениями\n      const extensions = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.vue', '.mjs', '.cjs', ''];\n      for (const ext of extensions) {\n        const testPath = normalizedResolvedPath + ext;\n        if (fs.existsSync(testPath) && fs.statSync(testPath).isFile()) {\n          return testPath;\n        }\n        // Проверка на index файл\n        const indexPath = path.join(normalizedResolvedPath, `index${ext}`);\n        if (ext && fs.existsSync(indexPath) && fs.statSync(indexPath).isFile()) {\n          return normalizePathForOS(indexPath);\n        }\n      }\n\n      return normalizedResolvedPath;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}",

          ],

          "body": "{\n  try {\n    const resolvedPath = resolveAbsolutePath(filePath);\n    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedPath)) {\n      console.warn(`⚠️ Файл не найден: ${resolvedPath}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const source = fs.readFileSync(resolvedPath, 'utf-8');\n    const { descriptor, errors } = parseVueSFC(source, {\n      filename: resolvedPath,\n      sourceMap: false,\n    });\n\n    if (errors.length > 0) {\n      console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибки парсинга Vue файла ${resolvedPath}:`, errors);\n    }\n\n    const result: VueSFCData = {\n      script: null,\n      scriptSetup: null,\n      template: null,\n      styles: [],\n      customBlocks: {},\n      scriptType: null,\n    };\n\n    if (descriptor.script) {\n      result.script = descriptor.script.content;\n      result.scriptType = 'basic';\n      if (descriptor.script.lang === 'ts') {\n        result.scriptType = 'ts';\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (descriptor.scriptSetup) {\n      result.scriptSetup = descriptor.scriptSetup.content;\n      result.scriptType = descriptor.scriptSetup.lang === 'ts' ? 'tsSetup' : 'setup';\n    }\n\n    // ✅ ДОБАВЛЯЕМ ПРОВЕРКУ НА ПУСТОЙ СКРИПТ\n    const scriptContent = result.scriptSetup || result.script;\n    if (scriptContent && scriptContent.trim() === '') {\n      console.log(`ℹ️ Пустой script блок в ${path.basename(filePath)}, пропускаем`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    if (descriptor.template) {\n      result.template = descriptor.template.content;\n    }\n\n    result.styles = descriptor.styles.map(style => style.content);\n\n    for (const [blockName, block] of Object.entries(descriptor.customBlocks || {})) {\n      if (!result.customBlocks[blockName]) {\n        result.customBlocks[blockName] = [];\n      }\n      result.customBlocks[blockName].push(block.content);\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`❌ Ошибка парсинга Vue файла ${filePath}:`, error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

          "body": "{\n  try {\n    const resolvedDir = path.isAbsolute(dir) ? dir : path.resolve(process.cwd(), dir);\n    if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedDir)) {\n      console.warn(`⚠️ Директория не найдена: ${resolvedDir}`);\n      return filesList;\n    }\n\n    const files = fs.readdirSync(resolvedDir);\n    for (const file of files) {\n      const name = path.join(resolvedDir, file);\n      if (excludePatterns.some(p => name.includes(p))) continue;\n      if (fs.statSync(name).isDirectory()) {\n        getAllProjectFiles(name, filesList, excludePatterns);\n      } else if (SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS.includes(path.extname(name))) {\n        filesList.push(name);\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn(\n      `⚠️ Ошибка чтения ${dir}:`,\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n    );\n  }\n  return filesList;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return false;\n\n  if (node.type === 'CallExpression' && node.callee) {\n    const callee = node.callee;\n    if (callee.type === 'Identifier') {\n      const name = callee.name;\n      if (\n        ['addEventListener', 'on', 'once', 'emit', 'dispatchEvent', 'addListener'].includes(name)\n      ) {\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n    if (callee.type === 'MemberExpression' && callee.property) {\n      const propName = callee.property.name || callee.property.value;\n      if (\n        ['addEventListener', 'on', 'once', 'emit', 'dispatchEvent', 'addListener'].includes(\n          propName\n        )\n      ) {\n        return true;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'JSXAttribute' && node.name) {\n    const attrName = node.name.name || node.name.value;\n    if (typeof attrName === 'string' && attrName.startsWith('on')) {\n      return true;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return undefined;\n\n  if (node.type === 'CallExpression' && node.callee) {\n    if (node.arguments && node.arguments.length > 0) {\n      const firstArg = node.arguments[0];\n      if (firstArg && firstArg.type === 'Literal' && typeof firstArg.value === 'string') {\n        return firstArg.value;\n      }\n      if (firstArg && firstArg.type === 'Identifier') {\n        return firstArg.name;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'JSXAttribute' && node.name) {\n    const attrName = node.name.name || node.name.value;\n    if (typeof attrName === 'string' && attrName.startsWith('on')) {\n      return attrName.slice(2).toLowerCase();\n    }\n  }\n\n  return undefined;\n}",

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  let complexity = 1;\n\n  function traverse(n: any) {\n    if (!n) return;\n\n    if (\n      n.type === 'IfStatement' ||\n      n.type === 'ConditionalExpression' ||\n      n.type === 'SwitchStatement'\n    ) {\n      complexity++;\n    }\n\n    if (\n      n.type === 'ForStatement' ||\n      n.type === 'ForInStatement' ||\n      n.type === 'ForOfStatement' ||\n      n.type === 'WhileStatement' ||\n      n.type === 'DoWhileStatement'\n    ) {\n      complexity++;\n    }\n\n    if (n.type === 'LogicalExpression' && (n.operator === '&&' || n.operator === '||')) {\n      complexity++;\n    }\n\n    if (n.type === 'CatchClause') {\n      complexity++;\n    }\n\n    for (const key of Object.keys(n)) {\n      const child = n[key];\n      if (child && typeof child === 'object') {\n        if (Array.isArray(child)) {\n          for (const item of child) {\n            traverse(item);\n          }\n        } else {\n          traverse(child);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  traverse(node);\n  return complexity;\n}",

          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const security = {\n    hasEval: false,\n    hasProcessEnv: false,\n    hasSensitiveData: false,\n    hasExec: false,\n    hasPassword: false,\n  };\n\n  if (!body) return security;\n\n  const bodyLower = body.toLowerCase();\n\n  security.hasEval = body.includes('eval(') || body.includes('eval (');\n  security.hasProcessEnv = body.includes('process.env');\n  security.hasExec =\n    body.includes('exec(') || body.includes('exec (') || body.includes('execSync(');\n  security.hasPassword = /\\b(password|passwd|pwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\\b/i.test(bodyLower);\n\n  const sensitivePatterns = [\n    /['\"][a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]{32,}['\"]/,\n    /'\"]sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}['\"]/,\n    /'\"]gh[pous]_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36,}['\"]/,\n    /'\"]xox[baprs]-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+['\"]/,\n  ];\n\n  for (const pattern of sensitivePatterns) {\n    if (pattern.test(body)) {\n      security.hasSensitiveData = true;\n      break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return security;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!body) return undefined;\n\n  if (body.type === 'BlockStatement') {\n    const statements = body.body || [];\n    if (statements.length === 0) return '{}';\n\n    const firstStatement = statements[0];\n    if (firstStatement && firstStatement.type === 'ReturnStatement') {\n      if (firstStatement.argument) {\n        const argType = firstStatement.argument.type;\n        if (argType === 'Identifier') return `return ${firstStatement.argument.name}`;\n        if (argType === 'Literal') return `return ${firstStatement.argument.value}`;\n        return 'return ...';\n      }\n      return 'return';\n    }\n\n    return `{ ${statements.length} statements }`;\n  }\n\n  if (body.type === 'Identifier') {\n    return body.name;\n  }\n\n  if (body.type === 'Literal') {\n    return String(body.value);\n  }\n\n  if (body.type === 'BinaryExpression') {\n    return `${extractBodyText(body.left)} ${body.operator} ${extractBodyText(body.right)}`;\n  }\n\n  return body.type || undefined;\n}",

(method.type === 'MethodDefinition' || method.type === 'PropertyDefinition') &&\n            method.key?.name\n          ) {\n            declarations[method.key.name] = { type: 'function', node: (node.declarations && Array.isArray(node.declarations)) {\n      node.declarations.forEach((decl: any) => {\n        if (decl.id?.name) {\n          declarations[decl.id.name] = { type: 'variable',   }\n  }\n\n  // ✅ НОВОЕ: собираем функции внутри IIFE и других выражений\n  if (node.type === 'CallExpression' && node.callee?.type === 'FunctionExpression') {\n    const funcNode = node.callee;\n    if (funcNode.id?.name) {\n      declarations[funcNode.id.name] = { type: 'function', node: funcNode };\n    }\n    // Также проверяем тело функции\n    if (funcNode.body) {\n      collectDeclarationsRecursive(funcNode.body, declarations, depth + 1, maxDepth);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ✅ НОВОЕ: собираем стрелочные функции в переменных\n  if (node.type === 'VariableDeclarator' && node.id?.name) {\n    if (\n      node.init &&\n      (node.init.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' || node.init.type === 'FunctionExpression')\n    ) {\n      declarations[node.id.name] = { type: }\n\n  // ⭐ ДЛЯ КЛАССОВ - отдельная обработка\n  if (node.type === 'ClassDeclaration' && node.body && Array.isArray(node.body.body)) {\n    childrenToTraverse.push(...node.body.body);\n  }\n\n  //  // properties (object expressions)\n  if (node.properties && Array.isArray(node.properties)) {\n    childrenToTraverse.push(...node.properties);\n  }\n\n  // elements (array expressions)\n  if           "body": "{\n  const ast = parseFile(filePath);\n\n  // ✅ УСИЛЕННАЯ ПРОВЕРКА AST\n  if (!ast) {\n    console.warn(`⚠️ Не удалось получить AST для файла: ${filePath}`);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // ✅ ПРОВЕРКА НА НАЛИЧИЕ body\n  if (!ast.body || !Array.isArray(ast.body)) {\n    console.warn(`⚠️ AST не содержит body для файла: ${filePath}`);\n    // Вместо null возвращаем пустой граф\n    return {\n      rootKey: normalizePathForDisplay(path.basename(filePath)),\n      graph: {},\n    };\n  }\n\n  const declarations: Record<string, { type: string; node: any }> = {};\n  const  // ✅ НОВОЕ: используем collectDeclaredFunctions для поиска пропущенных функций\n    const declaredFunctions = collectDeclaredFunctions(ast);\n    for (const funcName of declaredFunctions) {\n      if (!declarations[funcName]) {\n        // Находим узел функции в AST\n        let found = false;\n        function findFunction(node: any) {\n          if (found) return;\n          if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;\n\n          if (node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' && node.id?.name === funcName) {\n            declarations[funcName] = { type: 'function', node: node };\n            found = true;\n            return;\n          }\n\n          if (node.type === 'VariableDeclarator' && node.id?.name === funcName) {\n            if (\n              node.init &&\n              (node.init.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' ||\n                node.init.type === 'FunctionExpression')\n            ) {\n              declarations[funcName] = { type: 'function', node: node.init };\n              found = true;\n              return;\n            }\n          }\n\n          for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n            const child = node[key];\n            if (child && typeof child === 'object') {\n              if (Array.isArray(child)) {\n                for (const item of child) {\n                  if (item && typeof item === 'object') {\n                    findFunction(item);\n                  }\n                }\n              } else {\n                findFunction(child);\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        findFunction(ast);\n\n        if (found) {\n          console.log(`   🔍 Найдена пропущенная функция: ${funcName}`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибка при сборе объявлений: ${error}`);\n    // Возвращаем пустой граф вместо null\n    return {\n      rootKey: normalizePathForDisplay(path.basename(filePath)),\n      graph: {},\n    };\n  }\n\n  // ✅ НОВОЕ: используем buildCallGraphFromAST для полного графа вызовов\n  let callGraphFromAST: Map<string, Set<string>> | null = null;\n  try {\n    callGraphFromAST = buildCallGraphFromAST(ast);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn(`⚠️ Ошибка при построении графа вызовов из AST: ${error}`);\n  }\n\n  // Поиск связей между объявлениями\n  Object.keys(declarations).forEach((currentEntity: string) => {\n    const declaration = declarations[currentEntity];\n    if (!declaration) return;\n\n    const entityNode = declaration.node;\n\n    // ✅ Используем callGraphFromAST если доступен\n    if (callGraphFromAST) {\n      const calls = callGraphFromAST.get(currentEntity);\n      if (calls) {\n        for (const call of calls) {\n          if (call !== currentEntity && declarations[call]) {\n            relations.push({ from: currentEntity, to: call });\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ✅ ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНО: обход AST для поиска вызовов (как резерв)\n    walk(entityNode, {\n ли он на другое объявление в этом же файле\n          if (name !== currentEntity && declarations[name]) {\n            // Проверяем, что это не часть объявления\n            const parent = relations.push({ from: currentEntity, to: name });\n          }\n        }\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Формирование графа с нормализованными путями\n  const fileGraph: Record<string, string[]> = rel of relations) {\n    if (!uniqueRelations.has(rel.from)) {\n      uniqueRelations.set(rel.from, new Set());\n    }\n    uniqueRelations.get(rel.from)!.add(rel.to);\n  }\n\n  for (const [from, ${totalFunctions}`);\n  console.log(`      • Связей: ${totalEdges}`);\n  console.log(`      • Узлов: ${Object.keys(fileGraph).length}`);\n\n  if (totalEdges === 0 && totalFunctions > 0) {\n    console.log(`      ℹ️ Нет связей между функциями (возможно, все функции изолированы)`);\n  }\n\n  return {\n    rootKey: normalizedRootKey,\n    graph: fileGraph,\n  };\n}",

'typescript' : 'javascript';\n      markdown += `### ${count}. \\`${f}\\`\\n`;\n      markdown += `\\`\\`\\`${depLang}\\n${minifyForAI(abs)}\\n\\`\\`\\`\\n\\n`;\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (count === 0) {\n    markdown += '*⚠️ У этого файла нет локальных зависимостей в рамках указанной глубины.*\\n\\n';\n  }\n\n  return markdown;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const { maxDepth = 5, excludePatterns = DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS } = options;\n\n  // Проверка на исключение\n  for (const pattern of excludePatterns) {\n    if (filePath.includes(pattern)) {\n      console.log(`⏭️ Пропуск файла по паттерну: ${pattern}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  const ast = parseFile(filePath);\n  if (!ast) return null;\n\n  const code = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');\n  const lines = code.split('\\n');\n\n  const exports: any[] = [];\n  const imports: any[] = [];\n  const functions: any[] = [];\n  const classes: any[] = [];\n  const constants: any[] = [];\n  const interfaces: any[] = [];\n  const types: any[] = [];\n  const callGraph: Record<string, string[]> = {};\n  let currentFunction: string | null = null;\n  let currentDepth = 0;\n\n  walk(ast, {\n    enter(node: any) {\n      // Сбор импортов\n      if (node.type === 'ImportDeclaration' && node.source) {\n        const specifiers = node.specifiers.map((spec: any) => ({\n          local: spec.local.name,\n          imported:\n            spec.type === 'ImportSpecifier'\n              ? spec.imported.name\n              : spec.type === 'ImportDefaultSpecifier'\n                ?     // Сбор классов\n      if (node.type === 'ClassDeclaration' && node.id) {\n        classes.push({\n          name: node.id.name,\n          exported: exports.some((e: any) => e.name ===   if (decl.id && decl.id.name) {\n            constants.push({\n              name: decl.id.name,\n              type: 'constant',\n              loc: decl.loc,\n              startLine: });\n      }\n\n      // Анализ вызовов с ограничением глубины\n      if (\n        currentFunction &&\n        node.type === 'CallExpression' &&\n        node.callee.type === 'Identifier' &&\n 100 : 0) + (callFrequency[a.name] || 0);\n    const bScore = (b.exported ? 100 : 0) + (callFrequency[b.name] || 0);\n    return bScore - aScore;\n  });\n\n  for (const func of sortedFunctions) {\n    if (processed.has(func.name)) continue;\n\n    const cluster: {\n      name: string;\n      functions: string[];\n      isExported: boolean;\n      dependencies: string[];\n      importers: string[];\n      cohesionScore: number;\n      type?: 'core' | 'helper';\n      size?: number;\n      recommendation?: string;\n    } = {\n      name: `${func.name}Cluster`,\n      functions: [func.name],\n      isExported: func.exported,\n      dependencies: [...(callGraph[func.name] || [])],\n      importers: [],\n      cohesionScore: 0,\n    };\n\n    // BFS для сбора связанных функций\n    const queue = [func.name];\n    while (queue.length > 0 && cluster.functions.length < maxClusterSize) {\n      const current = queue.shift();\n      if (!current || processed.has(current)) continue;\n      processed.add(current);\n\n      const calls = callGraph[current] || [];\n      for (const call of calls) {\n        if (!cluster.functions.includes(call) && functions.some((f: any) => f.name === call)) {\n          cluster.functions.push(call);\n          if (cluster.functions.length < maxClusterSize) {\n            queue.push(call);\n          }\n          const callDeps = callGraph[call] || [];\n          cluster.dependencies.push(...callDeps);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (cluster.functions.length > 0) {\n      // Вычисление связности\n      const internalCalls = cluster.functions.reduce((count, fn) => {\n        const calls = callGraph[fn] || [];\n        return count + calls.filter((c: string) => cluster.functions.includes(c)).length;\n      }, 0);\n      const totalPossible = cluster.functions.length * (cluster.functions.length - 1);\n      cluster.cohesionScore = totalPossible > 0 ? (internalCalls / totalPossible) * 100 : 0;\n\n      // Определение типа\n      const hasExport = cluster.functions.some((f: string) =>\n        exports.some((e: any) => e.name === f)\n      );\n      cluster.type = hasExport ? 'core' : 'helper';\n      cluster.size = cluster.functions.length;\n\n      // Рекомендация по размеру\n      if (cluster.size < targetClusterSize) {\n        cluster.recommendation = '⚠️ Слишком маленький кластер.           "body": "{\n  const tree: any = {};\n\n  for (const relPath of relativePaths) {\n    const parts = relPath.split(path.sep);\n    let current = tree;\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {\n      const part = parts[i];\n      if (part === undefined) continue;\n\n      if (i === parts.length - 1) {\n        current[part] = null;\n      } else {\n        if (!current[part]) current[part] = {};\n        const nextCurrent = current[part];\n        if (nextCurrent && typeof nextCurrent === 'object') {\n          current = nextCurrent;\n        } else {\n          // Если текущий узел не является объектом, создаем новый\n          current[part] = {};\n          current = current[part];\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  function renderNode(node: any, indent = '', _prefix = ''): string {\n    let result = '';\n    const entries = Object.entries(node);\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {\n      const entry = entries[i];\n      if (!entry) continue;\n\n      const [name, children] = entry;\n      const isLast = i === entries.length - 1;\n      const marker = isLast ?           "returnType": "string | null",
          "calls": [
            "collectFiles",
            "generateDirectoryTree"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const {\n    outputFile = 'ai-project-context.md',\n    extensions = ['.js', '.ts', '.tsx', '.jsx', '.vue', '.mjs', '.cjs'],\n    excludePatterns = DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS,\n    maxDepth = 10,\n    showStructure = true,\n    addTableOfContents = true,\n    sortByType = true,\n  } = options;\n\n  const resolvedDir = path.resolve(inputDir);\n\n  if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedDir)) {\n    console.error(`❌ Каталог не существует: ${resolvedDir}`);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  console.log(`\\n📁 Сканирование: ${resolvedDir}`);\n  console.log(`📄 Расширения: ${extensions.join(', ')}`);\n  console.log(`🚫 Исключения: ${excludePatterns.join(', ')}\\n`);\n\n  const files = collectFiles(resolvedDir, extensions, excludePatterns, maxDepth);\n\n  if (files.length === 0) {\n    console.log(`⚠️ Файлы с расширениями ${extensions.join(', ')} не найдены`);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  console.log(`📊 Найдено файлов: ${files.length}\\n`);\n\n  if (sortByType) {\n    files.sort((a, b) => {\n      if (a.ext !== b.ext) return a.ext.localeCompare(b.ext);\n      return a.relativePath.localeCompare(b.relativePath);\n    });\n  }\n\n  let markdown = '# 🤖 AI Context - Полный проект\\n\\n';\n  markdown += `**Сгенерировано:** ${new Date().toLocaleString()}\\n`;\n  markdown += `**Исходная директория:** \\`${resolvedDir}\\`\\n`;\n  markdown += `**Всего файлов:** ${files.length}\\n`;\n  markdown += `**Общий размер:** ${(files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.size, 0) / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB\\n`;\n  markdown += '**Режим:** Сжатый (только сигнатуры, без реализации)\\n\\n';\n\n  markdown += '---\\n\\n';\n  markdown += '## 📋 ИНСТРУКЦИЯ ДЛЯ ИИ\\n\\n';\n  markdown +=\n    'Ты — AI ассистент, который анализирует код проекта. Ниже представлен **полный проект** в сжатом виде:\\n\\n';\n  markdown += '- ✅ **Сохранены:** импорты, экспорты, сигнатуры функций, JSDoc, TypeScript типы\\n';\n  markdown += '- ❌ **Удалены:** реализации функций, внутренние вычисления, локальные переменные\\n';\n  markdown += '- 🎯 **Цель:** Понимание архитектуры при минимальном расходе токенов\\n\\n';\n  markdown += '### Как использовать этот контекст:\\n\\n';\n  markdown += '1. Проанализируй структуру проекта\\n';\n  markdown += '2. Ответь на вопросы пользователя о взаимосвязях модулей\\n';\n  markdown += '3. Предложи рефакторинг, основываясь на предоставленных сигнатурах\\n\\n';\n  markdown += '---\\n\\n';\n\n  if (addTableOfContents) {\n    markdown += '## 📑 Оглавление\\n\\n';\n    const byExt: Record<string, FileInfo[]> = {};\n    for (const file of files) {\n      if (!byExt[file.ext]) {\n        byExt[file.ext] = [];\n      }\n      // Исправление: проверка на undefined перед push\n      const extArray = byExt[file.ext];\n      if (extArray) {\n        extArray.push(file);\n      }\n    }\n    for (const [ext, extFiles] of Object.entries(byExt)) {\n      markdown += `### ${ext} файлы (${extFiles.length})\\n`;\n      for (const file of extFiles) {\n        const anchor = file.relativePath.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-').toLowerCase();\n        markdown += `- [\\`${file.relativePath}\\`](#${anchor})\\n`;\n      }\n      markdown += '\\n';\n    }\n    markdown += '---\\n\\n';\n  }\n\n  if (showStructure) {\n    markdown += '## 📁 Структура проекта\\n\\n';\n    markdown += generateDirectoryTree(\n      resolvedDir,\n      files.map(f => f.relativePath),\n      excludePatterns\n    );\n    markdown += '\\n---\\n\\n';\n  }\n\n  markdown += '## 📄 Содержимое файлов\\n\\n';\n\n  let processedCount = 0;\n  let totalOriginalSize = 0;\n  let totalMinifiedSize = 0;\n\n  for (const file of files) {\n    processedCount++;\n    const progress = Math.round((processedCount / files.length) * 100);\n    process.stdout.write(`\\r   🏭 Минификация: ${processedCount}/${files.length} (${progress}%)`);\n\n    const minified = minifyForAI(file.path);\n    if (!minified) continue;\n\n    totalOriginalSize += file.size;\n    totalMinifiedSize += minified.length;\n\n    const lang =\n      file.ext === '.vue'\n        ? 'vue'\n        : ['.ts', '.tsx'].includes(file.ext)\n          ? 'typescript'\n          : 'javascript';\n\n    markdown += `### \\`${file.relativePath}\\`\\n`;\n    markdown += `\\`\\`\\`${lang}\\n${minified}\\n\\`\\`\\`\\n\\n`;\n    markdown += '---\\n\\n';\n  }\n\n  console.log('\\n');\n\n  const savedKB = (totalOriginalSize - totalMinifiedSize) / 1024;\n  const savedPercent =\n    totalOriginalSize > 0 ? ((1 - totalMinifiedSize / totalOriginalSize) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;\n\n  markdown += '## 📊 Статистика сжатия\\n\\n';\n  markdown += '| Показатель | Значение |\\n';\n  markdown += '|------------|----------|\\n';\n  markdown += `| Исходный размер | ${(totalOriginalSize / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB |\\n`;\n  markdown += `| Сжатый размер | ${(totalMinifiedSize / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB |\\n`;\n  markdown += `| Экономия | ${savedKB.toFixed(2)} KB (${savedPercent}%) |\\n`;\n  markdown += `| Количество файлов | ${files.length} |\\n\\n`;\n\n  fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, markdown, 'utf-8');\n\n  console.log(`\\n${'='.repeat(60)}`);\n  console.log('✅ ГОТОВО!');\n  console.log(`${'='.repeat(60)}`);\n  console.log(`📄 Выходной файл: ${path.resolve(outputFile)}`);\n  console.log(`📊 Размер: ${(totalMinifiedSize / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB (сжатие ${savedPercent}%)`);\n  console.log(`📁 Файлов обработано: ${files.length}`);\n  console.log('\\n💡 Отправьте этот файл в ИИ для анализа всего проекта!');\n\n  return markdown;\n}",

          "returnType": "Promise<import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/src/ci-cd/SemanticPipeline\").PipelineResult>",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const pipeline = new SemanticPipeline({ wasmPath: options.wasmPath });\n\n  const files: string[] = [];\n  for (const p of paths) {\n    if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\n      const stat = fs.statSync(p);\n      if (\n        stat.isFile() &&\n        (p.endsWith('.ts') || p.endsWith('.tsx') || p.endsWith('.js') || p.endsWith('.jsx'))\n      ) {\n        files.push(path.resolve(p));\n      } else if (stat.isDirectory()) {\n        const pattern = `${p}/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}`;\n        const matched = await glob(pattern, {\n          ignore: ['**/node_modules/**', '**/dist/**', '**/build/**'],\n        });\n        files.push(...matched.map(f => path.resolve(f)));\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (files.length === 0) {\n    console.error('❌ No files found to analyze');\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      metrics: {\n        totalFunctions: 0,\n        totalFiles: 0,\n        unusedFunctions: 0,\n        unusedVariables: 0,\n        potentialBugs: 0,\n        verifiedFunctions: 0,\n        cyclomaticComplexity: 0,\n        dataFlowIssues: 0,\n        typeErrors: 0,\n        cyclicDependencies: 0,\n        unreachableBlocks: 0,\n      },\n      issues: [],\n      verificationResults: [],\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      duration: 0,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return pipeline.run(files, options);\n}",

          "returnType": "import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/src/formal/Z3Verifier\").VerificationConstraint",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  // Нормализуем оператор\n  let normalizedOp: 'eq' | 'neq' | 'gt' | 'gte' | 'lt' | 'lte';\n  switch (operator) {\n    case '<':\n      normalizedOp = 'lt';\n      break;\n    case '<=':\n      normalizedOp = 'lte';\n      break;\n    case '>':\n      normalizedOp = 'gt';\n      break;\n    case '>=':\n      normalizedOp = 'gte';\n      break;\n    default:\n      normalizedOp = operator;\n  }\n\n  // Используем нормализованный оператор\n  switch (normalizedOp) {\n    case 'eq':\n      return { type: 'equality', left, right };\n    case 'neq':\n      return { type: 'inequality', left, right };\n    case 'gt':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: typeof right === 'number' ? right + 1 : 0,\n        max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n      };\n    case 'gte':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: typeof right === 'number' ? right : 0,\n        max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n      };\n    case 'lt':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n        max: typeof right === 'number' ? right - 1 : 0,\n      };\n    case 'lte':\n      return {\n        type: 'range',\n        variable: left,\n        min: -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n        max: typeof right === 'number' ? right : 0,\n      };\n    default:\n      return { type: 'equality', left, right };\n  }\n}",

`${targetModule}#${safeString(cls.extends)}`\n        : `#${safeString(cls.extends)}`;\n      edges.push({\n        from: nodeId,\n        to: targetId,\n        type: 'class_extends',\n      });\n    }\n\n    for (const impl of ensureArray(cls.implements)) {\n      const implName = safeString(impl);\n      const targetModule = findModuleForEntity(implName, data);\n      const targetId = targetModule ? VUE ФАЙЛЫ - используем analyzeVueComponent\n  // ============================================\n  if (filePath.endsWith('.vue')) {\n    try {\n      const vueAnalysis = analyzeVueComponent(filePath);\n      if (vueAnalysis) {\n        for (const func of vueAnalysis.functions || []) {\n          entities.functions.push(createEnhancedFunctionFromVue(func));\n        }\n\n        for (const constItem of vueAnalysis.constants || []) {\n          entities.constants.push(createEnhancedConstantFromVue(constItem));\n        }\n\n        for (const varItem of vueAnalysis.variables || []) {\n          entities.variables.push({\n            name: varItem.name || 'unknown',\n            line: varItem.line || 0,\n            isExported: varItem.isExported || false,\n            type: varItem.type || entities.interfaces.push(createEnhancedInterfaceFromVue(intf));\n        }\n\n        for (const type of vueAnalysis.types || []) {\n          entities.types.push(createEnhancedTypeFromVue(type));\n        }\n\n        // ✅ ДОБАВЛЯЕМ ИМПОРТЫ ИЗ VUE\n        for (const imp of vueAnalysis.imports || []) {\n          entities.imports!.push({\n            source: imp.source,\n            specifiers: ${entities.functions.length}`);\n        console.log(`   Констант: ${entities.constants.length}`);\n        console.log(`   Переменных: ${entities.variables.length}`);\n        console.log(`   Интерфейсов: ${entities.interfaces.length}`);\n        console.log(`   Типов: ${entities.types.length}`);\n        console.log(`   Импортов: ${entities.imports?.length || 0}`);\n\n        return entities;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(`⚠️ Vue-анализ не удался для ${path.basename(filePath)}:`, error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================\n  // ИЗВЛЕЧЕНИЕ ИМПОРТОВ (НОВОЕ!)\n    // ============================================\n    const importedNames = new Set<string>();\n    try {\n      const importDeclarations = sourceFile.getImportDeclarations();\n      for (const imp of importDeclarations) {\n        const moduleSpecifier = imp.getModuleSpecifierValue();\n        const specifiers: string[] = [];\n\n        const namedImports = imp.getNamedImports();\n        for (const named of namedImports) {\n          const name = named.getName();\n          specifiers.push(name);\n          importedNames.add(name);\n        }\n\n        const defaultImport = imp.getDefaultImport();\n        if (defaultImport) {\n          const name = defaultImport.getText();\n          specifiers.unshift(`default as ${name}`);\n          importedNames.add(name);\n        }\n\n        const namespaceImport = imp.getNamespaceImport();\n        if (namespaceImport) {\n          const name = namespaceImport.getText();\n          specifiers.push(`* as ${name}`);\n        }\n\n        if (moduleSpecifier && specifiers.length > 0) {\n          entities.imports!.push({\n            source: moduleSpecifier,\n            specifiers: specifiers,\n            isTypeOnly: false,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('⚠️ Ошибка при извлечении импортов:', error);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 2.1. КОПИРУЕМ interactive-report.js ИЗ TEMPLATES\n  // ============================================================\n  const jsSrc = path.join(templateDir, 'interactive-report.js');\n  const jsDest = path.join(outputDir, 'interactive-report.js');\n\n  if (fs.existsSync(jsSrc)) {\n    fs.copyFileSync(jsSrc, jsDest);\n    console.log(`  ✅ Скопирован: interactive-report.js`);\n  } else {\n    console.warn(`  ⚠️ interactive-report.js не найден в ${templateDir}`);\n  }\n\n  // ============================================================\n  // 4. const staticReplacements: Record<string, string> = {\n    __STAT_MODULES__: String(report.fileStats.totalFiles),\n    __STAT_FUNCTIONS__: String(report.entityStats.totalFunctions),\n Строим граф модулей (mgraph)\n  const mgraph: Record<number, number[]> = {};\n  for (const [fromMod, deps] of Object.entries(report.dependencyGraph?.outwardDependencies || {})) {\n    const fromIdx = modIdx.get(fromMod);\n    if (fromIdx === undefined) continue;\n    mgraph[fromIdx] = (deps || [])\n      .map(d => modIdx.get(d))\n      .filter((i): i is number => i !== undefined);\n  }\n\n  // 7. Строим граф функций (fgraph) - для уровней 1-3\n  const fgraph: Record<number, number[]> = {};\n  for (const [, idx] of funcIdx) {\n    fgraph[idx] = functions[idx]?.c || [];\n  }\n\n  // 8. Строим уровни (levels)\n  const levels: Record<number, number[]> = {};\n  if (report.architectureMetrics?.modulesByLevel) {\n    for (const [levelNum, mods] of Object.entries(report.architectureMetrics.modulesByLevel)) {\n      levels[Number(levelNum)] = mods\n        .map(m => modIdx.get(m))\n        .filter((i): i is number => i !== undefined);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 9. Статистика\n  const stats = {\n    funcs: functions.length,\n    mods: modulePaths.length,\n    calls: functions.reduce((sum, f) => sum + (f.c?.length || 0), 0),\n    size: report.fileStats?.totalSize || 0,\n    depth: report.architectureMetrics?.maxDepth || 0,\n    cycles: report.architectureMetrics?.hasCycles || false,\n  };\n\n  // 10. Формируем результат в зависимости от уровня\n  const result: CompressedReport = {\n    v: '3.0.1',\n    level: level,\n    root: modIdx.get(report.summary?.entryPoint || '') || 0,\n    time: report.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),\n    modules: modulePaths,\n    pkg: packages,\n    funcs: functions,\n    mgraph,\n    fgraph,\n    levels,\n    stats,\n  };\n\n  // Уровень 4: добавляем детальные вызовы\n  if (level >= 4) {\n    result.callDetails = {};\n    for (const [idx, details] of Object.entries(funcDetails)) {\n      const numIdx = Number(idx);\n      result.callDetails[numIdx] = {\n        calls: details.calls || [],\n        calledBy: details.calledBy || [],\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Уровень 5: добавляем полный контекст вызовов\n  if (level >= 5) {\n    result.callContext = {};\n    for (const [idx, details] of Object.entries(funcDetails)) {\n      const numIdx = Number(idx);\n      // Строим зависимости (уникальные вызываемые функции)\n      const deps = new Set<number>();\n      for (const call of details.calls || []) {\n        deps.add(call.to);\n      }\n\n      result.callContext[numIdx] = {\n        params: details.params || [],\n        returnType: details.returnType || 'any',\n        isExported: details.isExported || false,\n        isAsync: details.isAsync || false,\n        line: details.line || 0,\n        endLine: details.endLine || details.line || 0,\n        calls: details.calls || [],\n        calledBy: details.calledBy || [],\n        dependencies: Array.from(deps),\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Уровень 5: удаляем дублирующиеся данные из funcs\n    for (const func of result.funcs) {\n      delete func.c;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return result;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const result: Record<string, number> = {};\n\n  if (!body || !calls.length) {\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  const lines = body.split('\\n');\n\n  for (const call of calls) {\n    // Ищем вызов в каждой строке\n    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i];\n      if (!line) continue;\n\n      // Ищем паттерны вызовов: call(), call (, call(, call (\n      const patterns = [\n        new RegExp(`\\\\b${call}\\\\s*\\\\(`, 'g'),\n        new RegExp(`\\\\b${call}\\\\s*\\\\[`, 'g'),\n        new RegExp(`\\\\b${call}\\\\s*\\\\.`, 'g'),\n      ];\n\n      for (const pattern of patterns) {\n        pattern.lastIndex = 0;\n        if (pattern.test(line)) {\n          result[call] = i + 1;\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (result[call]) break;\n    }\n\n    // Если не нашли в теле, используем приблизительную линию\n    if (!result[call]) {\n      // Ищем вхождение имени функции в теле\n      const index = body.indexOf(call);\n      if (index !== -1) {\n        const lineCount = body.substring(0, index).split('\\n').length;\n        result[call] = lineCount + 1;\n      } else {\n        result[call] = 1;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return result;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!filePath) return '';\n\n  let normalized = filePath;\n\n  // Если путь абсолютный и нужно сделать относительным\n  if (path.isAbsolute(normalized) && options.relative !== false) {\n    try {\n      normalized = path.relative(baseDir, normalized);\n    } catch {\n      // Если не удалось сделать относительным, оставляем как есть\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Заменяем обратные слеши на прямые (Windows → Unix)\n  normalized = normalized.replace(/\\\\/g, '/');\n\n  // Убираем избыточные точки в начале пути (если они есть)\n  // Например: \"../../../src/index.ts\" → \"src/index.ts\"\n  if (normalized.startsWith('../')) {\n    const parts = normalized.split('/');\n    const filtered = parts.filter(p => p !== '..' && p !== '.');\n    if (filtered.length > 0) {\n      const candidate = filtered.join('/');\n      if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {\n        normalized = candidate;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return normalized;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const normalized = normalizePathForDisplay(filePath);\n  if (normalized.length <= maxLength) return normalized;\n\n  const parts = normalized.split('/');\n  if (parts.length <= 2) return normalized;\n\n  // ✅ Упрощенная логика: берем первый и последние 2 элемента\n  // Например: /home/user/project/src/very/long/nested/directory/structure/file.ts\n  // → /home/.../directory/structure/file.ts\n  let prefix = '';\n  let startIndex = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {\n    if (parts[i] === '..' || parts[i] === '.') {\n      prefix += parts[i] + '/';\n      startIndex = i + 1;\n    } else {\n      break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  const remaining = parts.slice(startIndex);\n  if (remaining.length <= 2) return normalized;\n\n  // ✅ Используем все части напрямую\n  const first = remaining[0] || '';\n  const lastTwo = remaining.slice(-2);\n\n  // Формируем сокращенный путь\n  let result = prefix;\n  if (first) {\n    result += first + '/.../';\n  }\n  result += lastTwo.join('/');\n\n  return result;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!filePath) return false;\n\n  // Нормализуем путь\n  const normalizedPath = normalizePathForOS(filePath);\n\n  if (!fs.existsSync(normalizedPath)) return false;\n\n  // Для Windows/macOS - регистр не важен\n  if (process.platform === 'win32' || process.platform === 'darwin') {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // Для Linux - проверяем регистр\n  const dir = path.dirname(normalizedPath);\n  const base = path.basename(normalizedPath);\n  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return false;\n\n  try {\n    const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);\n    return files.includes(base);\n  } catch {\n    return false;\n  }\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!filePath) return false;\n\n  // Проверяем длину пути (Windows ограничение 260 символов)\n  if (filePath.length > 260) return false;\n\n  // Проверяем запрещенные символы в Windows\n  const invalidChars = /[<>:\"|?*]/;\n  if (invalidChars.test(filePath)) return false;\n\n  // Проверяем зарезервированные имена\n  const reservedNames = [\n    'CON',\n    'PRN',\n    'AUX',\n    'NUL',\n    'COM1',\n    'COM2',\n    'COM3',\n    'COM4',\n    'COM5',\n    'COM6',\n    'COM7',\n    'COM8',\n    'COM9',\n    'LPT1',\n    'LPT2',\n    'LPT3',\n    'LPT4',\n    'LPT5',\n    'LPT6',\n    'LPT7',\n    'LPT8',\n    'LPT9',\n  ];\n\n  const baseName = path.basename(filePath).toUpperCase();\n  if (reservedNames.includes(baseName)) return false;\n\n  return true;\n}",

          ],

          "calls": [
            "traverse"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const calls: string[] = [];\n  const visited = new WeakSet<any>();\n  const includeAll = options?.includeAllIdentifiers !== false;\n  // ✅ ИСПОЛЬЗУЕМ includeLocal для фильтрации локальных вызовов\n  const includeLocal = options?.includeLocalCalls !== false;\n\n  function traverse(n: any) {\n    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;\n    if (visited.has(n)) return;\n    visited.add(n);\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 1. ПРЯМОЙ ВЫЗОВ ФУНКЦИИ: func()\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'CallExpression' && n.callee?.type === 'Identifier') {\n      const name = n.callee.name;\n      if (name && name !== currentFunction) {\n        // ✅ Проверяем, является ли функция локальной\n        const isLocal = functionNames.has(name);\n        // ✅ Если includeLocal=true, добавляем ВСЕ вызовы\n        // ✅ Если includeLocal=false, добавляем только НЕ локальные (внешние)\n        if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n          calls.push(name);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 2. ВЫЗОВ МЕТОДА: obj.method()\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'CallExpression' && n.callee?.type === 'MemberExpression') {\n      const property = n.callee.property;\n      if (property?.type === 'Identifier') {\n        const methodName = property.name;\n        if (methodName) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(methodName);\n          // ✅ Добавляем только если includeLocal=true или метод не локальный\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(methodName);\n          }\n        }\n        // ✅ ДОБАВЛЯЕМ даже если метод не объявлен (может быть извне)\n        if (includeAll && methodName) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(methodName);\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(methodName);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 3. НОВОЕ ВЫРАЖЕНИЕ: new Class()\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'NewExpression') {\n      if (n.callee?.type === 'Identifier') {\n        const name = n.callee.name;\n        if (name) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(name);\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(name);\n          }\n        }\n        if (includeAll && name) {\n          const isLocal = functionNames.has(name);\n          if (includeLocal || !isLocal) {\n            calls.push(name);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 4. АРГУМЕНТЫ ВЫЗОВА (вложенные вызовы)\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'CallExpression' && n.arguments) {\n      for (const arg of n.arguments) {\n        traverse(arg);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 5. RETURN STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ReturnStatement' && n.argument) {\n      traverse(n.argument);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 6. VARIABLE DECLARATOR\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'VariableDeclarator' && n.init) {\n      traverse(n.init);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 7. ASSIGNMENT EXPRESSION\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'AssignmentExpression' && n.right) {\n      traverse(n.right);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 8. CONDITIONAL EXPRESSION (тернарный оператор)\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ConditionalExpression') {\n      traverse(n.consequent);\n      if (n.alternate) traverse(n.alternate);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 9. IF STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'IfStatement') {\n      traverse(n.consequent);\n      if (n.alternate) traverse(n.alternate);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 10. LOOP STATEMENTS\n    // ============================================\n    if (['ForStatement', 'WhileStatement', 'DoWhileStatement'].includes(n.type)) {\n      if (n.body) traverse(n.body);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 11. FOR-IN / FOR-OF\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ForInStatement' || n.type === 'ForOfStatement') {\n      if (n.body) traverse(n.body);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 12. SWITCH STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'SwitchStatement' && n.cases) {\n      for (const caseItem of n.cases) {\n        if (caseItem.consequent) {\n          for (const consequent of caseItem.consequent) {\n            traverse(consequent);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 13. BLOCK STATEMENT\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'BlockStatement' && n.body) {\n      for (const child of n.body) {\n        traverse(child);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 14. OBJECT EXPRESSION\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ObjectExpression' && n.properties) {\n      for (const prop of n.properties) {\n        if (prop.value) traverse(prop.value);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 15. ARRAY EXPRESSION\n    // ============================================\n    if (n.type === 'ArrayExpression' && n.elements) {\n      for (const elem of n.elements) {\n        traverse(elem);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================\n    // 16.           "body": "{\n  const callers: string[] = [];\n  const declaredFunctions = collectDeclaredFunctions(ast);\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return callers;\n\n  function findFunctionNode(funcName: string): any {\n    let result: any = null;\n    let found = false;\n\n    function search(node: any) {\n      if (found) return;\n      if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;\n\n      if (node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' && node.id?.name === funcName) {\n        result = node;\n        found = true;\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (node.type === 'VariableDeclarator' && node.id?.name === funcName) {\n        if (\n          node.init &&\n          (node.init.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' || node.init.type === 'FunctionExpression')\n        ) {\n          result = node.init;\n          found = true;\n          return;\n        }\n      }\n\n      for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n        const child = node[key];\n        if (child && typeof child === 'object') {\n          if (Array.isArray(child)) {\n            for (const item of child) {\n              if (item && typeof item === 'object') {\n                search(item);\n              }\n            }\n          } else {\n            search(child);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    search(ast);\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  // Для каждой объявленной функции проверяем, вызывает ли она targetFunction\n  for (const funcName of declaredFunctions) {\n    if (funcName === targetFunction) continue;\n\n    const funcNode = findFunctionNode(funcName);\n    if (funcNode) {\n      const calls = collectCallsFromFunction(funcNode, declaredFunctions, funcName);\n      if (calls.includes(targetFunction)) {\n        callers.push(funcName);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return callers;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!filePath.endsWith('.vue')) {\n    console.error('❌ Файл не является Vue компонентом');\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {\n    console.error(`❌ Файл не найден: ${filePath}`);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  let fileContent = '';\n  try {\n    fileContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`❌ Ошибка чтения файла ${filePath}:`, error);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  const parsed = parseVueFile(filePath);\n  if (!parsed) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  const { descriptor } = parsed;\n\n  // ✅ Пытаемся скомпилировать script, но не блокируемся при ошибке\n  const compiledScript = compileScriptBlock(descriptor, filePath);\n  const templateAnalysis = analyzeTemplate(descriptor, options);\n\n  const originalScriptContent = descriptor.scriptSetup?.content || descriptor.script?.content || '';\n  const isSetup = !!descriptor.scriptSetup;\n  const isTS = !!(descriptor.scriptSetup?.lang === 'ts' || descriptor.script?.lang === 'ts');\n\n  // 1.           "body": "{\n  // Если исходный файл TypeScript, используем .ts\n  if (sourcePath.endsWith('.ts') || sourcePath.endsWith('.tsx')) {\n    return '.ts';\n  }\n\n  // Если есть TypeScript-специфичные конструкции, но файл не .ts, используем .js\n  if (hasTypeScriptSyntax(code) && !sourcePath.endsWith('.ts')) {\n    return '.js';\n  }\n\n  // Проверяем наличие top-level await\n  if (/(?:^|\\n)\\s*await\\s+/.test(code) && !/async\\s+function/.test(code)) {\n    return '.mjs';\n  }\n\n  // Проверяем наличие ESM-специфичных конструкций\n  if (hasESMSpecificSyntax(code)) {\n    return '.mjs';\n  }\n\n  // По умолчанию используем расширение, определенное ранее\n  return defaultType === 'esm' ?           "body": "{\n  const possiblePaths = [\n    // Относительно текущего файла (из dist/)\n    path.resolve(__dirname, 'wasm'),\n    // Относительно текущего файла (из src/)\n    path.resolve(__dirname, '../dist/wasm'),\n    // Относительно текущего файла (из подпапки)\n    path.resolve(__dirname, '../../dist/wasm'),\n    // В корне проекта (для монорепозиториев)\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'packages/ast-analyzer/dist/wasm'),\n    // В папке grammars проекта\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'grammars'),\n    // В node_modules (если установлен как пакет)\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'node_modules/@newkind/ast-analyzer/dist/wasm'),\n    // В корне проекта\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'wasm'),\n    // В dist проекта\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'dist/wasm'),\n  ];\n\n  for (const p of possiblePaths) {\n    if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\n      try {\n        const files = fs.readdirSync(p);\n        const hasWasm = files.some(f => f.endsWith('.wasm'));\n        if (hasWasm) {\n          console.log(`✅ WASM found at: ${p}`);\n          return p;\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        // Игнорируем ошибки чтения директории\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Если не найдено, выводим предупреждение и возвращаем путь по умолчанию\n  console.warn('⚠️ WASM directory not found.           "body": "{\n  const wasmSource = findWasmPath();\n  if (!fs.existsSync(wasmSource)) {\n    console.error('❌ WASM source directory not found');\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  const target = path.resolve(process.cwd(), targetPath);\n\n  try {\n    // Удаляем существующий симлинк если есть\n    if (fs.existsSync(target)) {\n      fs.unlinkSync(target);\n    }\n\n    // Создаем симлинк\n    fs.symlinkSync(wasmSource, target, 'dir');\n    console.log(`✅ Symlink created: ${target} -> ${wasmSource}`);\n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ Failed to create symlink:', error);\n    return false;\n  }\n}",

          "line": 124,

          "params": [

          "returnType": "number",
          "calls": [

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const wasmSource = findWasmPath();\n  if (!fs.existsSync(wasmSource)) {\n    console.error('❌ WASM source directory not found');\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  const target = path.resolve(process.cwd(), targetPath);\n  if (!fs.existsSync(target)) {\n    fs.mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true });\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const files = fs.readdirSync(wasmSource).filter(f => f.endsWith('.wasm'));\n    let copied = 0;\n\n    for (const file of files) {\n      const src = path.join(wasmSource, file);\n      const dest = path.join(target, file);\n      fs.copyFileSync(src, dest);\n      copied++;\n    }\n\n    console.log(`✅ Copied ${copied} WASM files to: ${target}`);\n    return copied;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ Failed to copy WASM files:', error);\n    return 0;\n  }\n}",

          "body": "{\n  try {\n    const vars = new Map<string, any>();\n    for (const param of params) {\n      if (param.type === 'int') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.Int.const(param.name));\n      } else if (param.type === 'bool') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.Bool.const(param.name));\n      } else if (param.type === 'string') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.String.const(param.name));\n      }\n    }\n\n    const parser = new ExpressionParser(context);\n    return parser.parse(body, vars);\n  } catch (error) {\n    return null;\n  }\n}",
          "startLine": 1020,
          "endLine": 1042,
          "isMethod": false,

          "parentFunction": "",

        {

          "body": "{\n  const vars = new Map<string, any>();\n  for (const param of params) {\n    if (param.type === 'int') {\n      vars.set(param.name, context.Int.const(param.name));\n    } else if (param.type === 'bool') {\n      vars.set(param.name, context.Bool.const(param.name));\n    } else if (param.type === 'string') {\n      vars.set(param.name, context.String.const(param.name));\n    }\n  }\n  return vars;\n}",

          "depth": 0,

        {
          "name": "verifyFunctionWithBody",
          "line": 1077,
          "isAsync": true,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "body",
            "params",
            "returnType",
            "contract",

            "solver"
          ],
          "returnType": "Promise<{ isValid: boolean; counterexample?: Map<string, any> | undefined; error?: string | undefined; time: number; }>",
          "calls": [
            "String"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const startTime = Date.now();\n\n  try {\n    const vars = new Map<string, any>();\n    for (const param of params) {\n      if (param.type === 'int') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.Int.const(param.name));\n      } else if (param.type === 'bool') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.Bool.const(param.name));\n      } else if (param.type === 'string') {\n        vars.set(param.name, context.String.const(param.name));\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Создаем переменную для результата\n    let resultVar = null;\n    if (returnType !== 'void') {\n      if (returnType === 'int') {\n        resultVar = context.Int.const('result');\n      } else if (returnType === 'bool') {\n        resultVar = context.Bool.const('result');\n      } else if (returnType === 'string') {\n        resultVar = context.String.const('result');\n      }\n    }\n\n    const parser = new ExpressionParser(context);\n    const bodyExpr = parser.parse(body, vars);\n\n    if (bodyExpr && resultVar) {\n      solver.add(context.Eq(resultVar, bodyExpr));\n    }\n\n    // Добавляем предусловия\n    if (contract.preconditions) {\n      for (const pre of contract.preconditions) {\n        const constraint = parser.parse(pre, vars);\n        if (constraint) {\n          solver.add(constraint);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Добавляем постусловия\n    if (contract.postconditions) {\n      for (const post of contract.postconditions) {\n        const constraint = parser.parse(post, vars);\n        if (constraint) {\n          solver.add(constraint);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await solver.check();\n\n    if (result === 'unsat') {\n      return { isValid: true, time: Date.now() - startTime };\n    } else if (result === 'sat') {\n      const model = solver.model();\n      const counterexample = new Map<string, any>();\n      for (const [name, varExpr] of vars) {\n        try {\n          const value = model.eval(varExpr);\n          if (value) {\n            counterexample.set(name, value.toString());\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          // Игнорируем\n        }\n      }\n      return {\n        isValid: false,\n        counterexample,\n        time: Date.now() - startTime,\n      };\n    } else {\n      return {\n        isValid: false,\n        error: 'Z3 returned unknown',\n        time: Date.now() - startTime,\n      };\n    }\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    return {\n      isValid: false,\n      error: error.message || String(error),\n      time: Date.now() - startTime,\n    };\n  }\n}",
          "startLine": 1077,
          "endLine": 1174,

          "body": "{\n  const preconditions = autoPreconditions.map(p => ({\n    type: 'range',\n    variable: p.variable,\n    min: p.min,\n    max: p.max,\n  }));\n\n  const postconditions: any[] = [];\n  if (returnType === 'int') {\n    postconditions.push({\n      type: 'range',\n      variable: 'result',\n      min: -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n      max: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,\n    });\n  } else if (returnType === 'bool') {\n    postconditions.push({\n      type: 'or',\n      constraints: [\n        { type: 'equality', left: 'result', right: true },\n        { type: 'equality', left: 'result', right: false },\n      ],\n    });\n  }\n\n  return {\n    name,\n    params,\n    returnType,\n    preconditions,\n    postconditions,\n    invariants: [],\n    body: expression,\n  };\n}",

Строим отчет\n    const report = buildHybridReport(entryPoint, maxDepth);\n\n    // 2. Проверка на валидность отчета\n    if (!report || !report.modules) {\n      throw new Error('Отчет не содержит данных');\n    }\n\n    // 3. Сохраняем JSON\n    console.log('\\n📄 Сохранение JSON отчета...');\n    const jsonPath = path.join(outputDir, 'hybrid-report.json');\n    fs.writeFileSync(jsonPath, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));\n    console.log(`   ✅ ${jsonPath}`);\n\n    // 4. Сохраняем DOT граф\n    console.log('📄 Сохранение DOT графа...');\n    const dotPath = path.join(outputDir, 'hybrid-report.dot');\n    const dot = generateHybridDOT(report);\n    fs.writeFileSync(dotPath, dot);\n    console.log(`   ✅ ${dotPath}`);\n\n    // 6. Сохраняем внутренние графы файлов\n    console.log('\\n📄 Генерация внутренних графов файлов...');\n    let internalGraphsCount = 0;\n    for (const module of report.modules) {\n      try {\n        const internalGraph = buildFileInternalGraph(module.path);\n        if (internalGraph && Object.keys(internalGraph.graph).length > 0) {\n          const graphPath = path.join(\n            outputDir,\n            `internal-${module.name.replace(/\\.[^.]+$/, '')}.json`\n          );\n          fs.writeFileSync(graphPath, JSON.stringify(internalGraph, null, 2));\n          console.log(`   ✅ internal-${module.name.replace(/\\.[^.]+$/, '')}.json`);\n          internalGraphsCount++;\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(\n          `   ⚠️ Не удалось построить граф для ${module.name}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`\n        );\n      }\n    }\n    console.log(`   📊 Сгенерировано внутренних графов: ${internalGraphsCount}`);\n\n    // 8. Сохраняем DOT с convertToDOT для дополнительной визуализации\n    console.log('\\n📄 Генерация дополнительных DOT графов...');\n    let dotGraphsCount = 0;\n    for (const module of report.modules) {\n      try {\n        const internalGraph = buildFileInternalGraph(module.path);\n        if (internalGraph && Object.keys(internalGraph.graph).length > 0) {\n          const cyclicEdges = findCyclicEdges(internalGraph.graph);\n          const dotContent = convertToDOT(internalGraph, cyclicEdges);\n          const dotInternalPath = path.join(\n            outputDir,\n            `internal-${module.name.replace(/\\.[^.]+$/, '')}.dot`\n          );\n          fs.writeFileSync(dotInternalPath, dotContent);\n          console.log(`   ✅ internal-${module.name.replace(/\\.[^.]+$/, '')}.dot`);\n          dotGraphsCount++;\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(\n          `   ⚠️ Не удалось построить DOT для ${module.name}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`\n        );\n      }\n    }\n    console.log(`   📊 Сгенерировано DOT графов: ${dotGraphsCount}`);\n\n    // 9. error.message : String(error)}`);\n    if (error instanceof Error && error.stack) {\n      console.error('\\n📚 Стек ошибки:');\n      console.error(error.stack);\n    }\n\n    // Возвращаем пустой отчет при ошибке\n    return {\n      root: entryPoint,\n      modules: [],\n      graph: { nodes: [], edges: [] },\n      stats: {\n        totalModules: 0,\n        totalFunctions: 0,\n        totalExports: 0,\n        totalImports: 0,\n        totalComponents: 0,\n        totalComposables: 0,\n        maxDepth: maxDepth,\n        cycles: 0,\n        byLevel: {},\n      },\n      cycles: [],\n      levels: {},\n    };\n  }\n}",

        {
          "name": "buildHybridReport",
          "line": 16,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "entryPoint",
            "maxDepth"
          ],
          "returnType": "import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/src/modes/hybrid-report/types\").HybridReport",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  console.log('\\n🔀 ГИБРИДНЫЙ ОТЧЕТ: МОДУЛИ + ФУНКЦИИ');\n  console.log('='.repeat(70));\n  console.log(`📄 Точка входа: ${entryPoint}`);\n  console.log(`📏 Глубина: ${maxDepth}`);\n\n  const startTime = Date.now();\n\n  // 1. Строим граф зависимостей проекта\n  const projectGraph = buildProjectGraph(entryPoint, maxDepth);\n\n  // 2. Инициализируем структуры данных\n  const modules = new Map<string, HybridModule>();\n  const allNodes: HybridNode[] = [];\n  const allEdges: { from: string; to: string; type: string; level?: number }[] = [];\n  const cycles: string[][] = [];\n\n  // 3. Собираем все файлы из графа\n  const allFiles = new Set<string>();\n  allFiles.add(projectGraph.rootKey);\n\n  for (const [file, deps] of Object.entries(projectGraph.graph)) {\n    allFiles.add(file);\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      allFiles.add(dep);\n    }\n  }\n\n  console.log(`\\n📁 Найдено модулей: ${allFiles.size}`);\n\n  // 4. Вычисляем уровни (BFS от корня)\n  const fileLevels = new Map<string, number>();\n  const queue: { file: string; level: number }[] = [{ file: projectGraph.rootKey, level: 0 }];\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n\n  while (queue.length > 0) {\n    const { file, level } = queue.shift()!;\n    if (visited.has(file)) continue;\n    visited.add(file);\n    fileLevels.set(file, level);\n\n    const deps = projectGraph.graph[file] || [];\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      if (!visited.has(dep) && !fileLevels.has(dep)) {\n        queue.push({ file: dep, level: level + 1 });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 5. Анализируем каждый файл\n  let processed = 0;\n  for (const filePath of allFiles) {\n    const absPath = path.resolve(filePath);\n    if (!fs.existsSync(absPath)) continue;\n\n    processed++;\n    const progress = Math.round((processed / allFiles.size) * 100);\n    process.stdout.write(`\\r   🔍 Анализ: ${processed}/${allFiles.size} (${progress}%)`);\n\n    const level = fileLevels.get(filePath) ?? 0;\n    const moduleInfo = analyzeModule(absPath, level);\n\n    if (moduleInfo) {\n      modules.set(filePath, moduleInfo);\n\n      // Добавляем узел модуля\n      const moduleNode: HybridNode = {\n        id: filePath,\n        type: moduleInfo.type === 'vue' ? 'component' : 'module',\n        name: moduleInfo.name,\n        file: filePath,\n        level: level,\n        exports: moduleInfo.exports,\n        imports: moduleInfo.imports,\n        functions: moduleInfo.functions,\n        children: moduleInfo.functions.map(f => ({\n          id: `${filePath}#${f.name}`,\n          type: 'function',\n          name: f.name,\n          file: filePath,\n          line: f.line,\n          level: level,\n          calls: f.calls,\n          calledBy: f.calledBy,\n          metadata: {\n            isExported: f.isExported,\n            isAsync: f.isAsync,\n            params: f.params,\n            returnType: f.returnType,\n            exportSource: f.exportSource,\n            exportModule: f.exportModule,\n            startLine: f.startLine,\n            endLine: f.endLine,\n          },\n        })),\n        metadata: {\n          components: moduleInfo.components,\n          composables: moduleInfo.composables,\n          level: level,\n        },\n      };\n      allNodes.push(moduleNode);\n\n      // Добавляем ребра зависимостей\n      const deps = projectGraph.graph[filePath] || [];\n      for (const dep of deps) {\n        const depLevel = fileLevels.get(dep) ?? 0;\n        allEdges.push({\n          from: filePath,\n          to: dep,\n          type: 'import',\n          level: depLevel,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  console.log(' ✅');\n\n  // 6. Находим циклические зависимости\n  const cyclicEdges = findCyclicEdges(projectGraph.graph);\n  for (const edge of cyclicEdges) {\n    const [from, to] = edge.split('->');\n    if (from && to) {\n      cycles.push([from, to]);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 7. Собираем статистику по уровням\n  const byLevel: Record<number, { modules: number; functions: number }> = {};\n  let totalFunctions = 0;\n  let totalExports = 0;\n  let totalImports = 0;\n  let totalComponents = 0;\n  let totalComposables = 0;\n\n  for (const module of modules.values()) {\n    const level = module.level;\n    if (!byLevel[level]) {\n      byLevel[level] = { modules: 0, functions: 0 };\n    }\n    byLevel[level].modules++;\n    byLevel[level].functions += module.functions.length;\n\n    totalFunctions += module.functions.length;\n    totalExports += module.exports.length;\n    totalImports += module.imports.length;\n    totalComponents += module.components.length;\n    totalComposables += module.composables.length;\n  }\n\n  // 8. Формируем итоговый отчет\n  const stats = {\n    totalModules: modules.size,\n    totalFunctions,\n    totalExports,\n    totalImports,\n    totalComponents,\n    totalComposables,\n    maxDepth,\n    cycles: cycles.length,\n    byLevel,\n  };\n\n  const report: HybridReport = {\n    root: projectGraph.rootKey,\n    modules: Array.from(modules.values()),\n    graph: {\n      nodes: allNodes,\n      edges: allEdges,\n    },\n    stats,\n    cycles,\n    levels: Object.fromEntries(fileLevels),\n  };\n\n  const duration = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(2);\n  console.log(`\\n⏱️  Готово за ${duration} сек`);\n  console.log(`📊 Модулей: ${stats.totalModules}, Функций: ${stats.totalFunctions}`);\n\n  return report;\n}",
