ИЗВЛЕЧЕНИЕ ИМПОРТОВ С ПОЛНОЙ ИНФОРМАЦИЕЙ\n  // ============================================\n  const importMatches = content.match(/import\\s+.*?from\\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]/g);\n  if (importMatches) {\n    for (const imp of importMatches) {\n      const sourceMatch = imp.match(/from\\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]/);\n      if (sourceMatch && sourceMatch[1]) {\n        const source = sourceMatch[1];\n        imports.push(source);\n\n        // Извлекаем импортируемые имена\n        const namesMatch = imp.match(/import\\s+(?:type\\s+)?(?:\\{([^}]+)\\}|(\\w+)|(\\*\\s+as\\s+\\w+))/);\n        if (namesMatch) {\n          let importedNames: string[] = [];\n          if (namesMatch[1]) {\n            // Named imports: import { a, b } from '...'\n            importedNames = namesMatch[1].split(',').map((s: string) => s.trim());\n          } else if (namesMatch[2]) {\n            // Default import: import x from '...'\n            importedNames = [namesMatch[2]];\n          }\n\n          // Добавляем импортированные функции как внешние\n          for (const importedName of importedNames) {\n            if (importedName && !functions.find((f: HybridFunction) => f.name === importedName)) {\n              functions.push({\n                name: importedName,\n                line: 0,\n                isExported: false,\n                isAsync: false,\n                calls: [],\n                calledBy: [],\n                params: [],\n                returnType: undefined,\n                body: '',\n                startLine: 0,\n                endLine: 0,\n                exportSource: 'external',\n                exportModule: source,\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================\n  // 2. ИЗВЛЕЧЕНИЕ ЭКСПОРТОВ\n  // ============================================\n  const exportMatches = content.match(\n    /export\\s+(?:default\\s+)?(?:function|const|let|var|class)\\s+(\\w+)/g\n  );\n  if (exportMatches) {\n    for (const exp of exportMatches) {\n      const nameMatch = exp.match(/(?:default\\s+)?(?:function|const|let|var|class)\\s+(\\w+)/);\n      if (nameMatch && nameMatch[1]) {\n        exports.push(nameMatch[1]);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================\n  // 3. ИЗВЛЕЧЕНИЕ ФУНКЦИЙ С ПОЛНОЙ ИНФОРМАЦИЕЙ\n  // ============================================\n  const functionMatches = content.match(\n    /(?:export\\s+)?(?:async\\s+)?function\\s+(\\w+)\\s*\\(([^)]*)\\)\\s*{([\\s\\S]*?)(?=\\n\\s*\\})/g\n  );\n  if (functionMatches) {\n    for (const func of functionMatches) {\n      const nameMatch = func.match(/(?:export\\s+)?(?:async\\s+)?function\\s+(\\w+)/);\n      const paramsMatch = func.match(/\\(([^)]*)\\)/);\n      const bodyMatch = func.match(/{\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)\\s*}/);\n\n      const isExported = func.trim().startsWith('export');\n      const isAsync = func.includes('async');\n\n      if (nameMatch && nameMatch[1]) {\n        const name = nameMatch[1];\n        const params =\n          paramsMatch && paramsMatch[1]\n            ? paramsMatch[1]\n                .split(',')\n                .map((p: string) => p.trim())\n                .filter((p: string) => p)\n            : [];\n        const body = bodyMatch && bodyMatch[1] ? bodyMatch[1].trim() : '';\n\n        // Находим вызовы внутри функции\n        const calls: string[] = [];\n        if (body) {\n          const callMatches = body.match(/\\b(\\w+)\\s*\\(/g);\n          if (callMatches) {\n            for (const call of callMatches) {\n              const calledName = call.replace(/\\s*\\(/, '');\n              if (calledName && calledName !== name) {\n                calls.push(calledName);\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Определяем источник экспорта\n        let exportSource: 'self' | 'external' | 're-export' = 'self';\n        let exportModule: string | undefined;\n        if (isExported) {\n          exportSource = 'self';\n        } else {\n          // Проверяем, импортирована ли функция\n          for (const imp of imports) {\n            if (imp.includes(name) || imp.endsWith(name)) {\n              exportSource = 'external';\n              exportModule = imp;\n              break;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        const line = content.substring(0, func.indexOf(name)).split('\\n').length;\n        const startLine = content.substring(0, func.indexOf(name)).split('\\n').length;\n        const endLine = startLine + func.split('\\n').length;\n\n        functions.push({\n          name,\n          line,\n          isExported,\n          isAsync,\n          calls: [...new Set(calls)],\n          calledBy: [],\n          params,\n          returnType: undefined,\n          body: body.length > 200 ? body.substring(0, 200) + '...' : body,\n          startLine,\n          endLine,\n          exportSource,\n          exportModule,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================\n  // 4. ИЗВЛЕЧЕНИЕ СТРЕЛОЧНЫХ ФУНКЦИЙ\n  // ============================================\n  const arrowMatches = content.match(\n    /(?:export\\s+)?(?:const|let)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*(?:async\\s*)?\\([^)]*\\)\\s*=>\\s*{([\\s\\S]*?)(?=\\n\\s*\\})/g\n  );\n  if (arrowMatches) {\n    for (const arrow of arrowMatches) {\n      const nameMatch = arrow.match(/(?:export\\s+)?(?:const|let)\\s+(\\w+)/);\n      const bodyMatch = arrow.match(/{\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)\\s*}/);\n      const isExported = arrow.trim().startsWith('export');\n      const isAsync = arrow.includes('async');\n\n      if (nameMatch && nameMatch[1]) {\n        const name = nameMatch[1];\n        const body = bodyMatch && bodyMatch[1] ? bodyMatch[1].trim() : '';\n        const calls: string[] = [];\n\n        if (body) {\n          const callMatches = body.match(/\\b(\\w+)\\s*\\(/g);\n          if (callMatches) {\n            for (const call of callMatches) {\n              const calledName = call.replace(/\\s*\\(/, '');\n              if (calledName && calledName !== name) {\n                calls.push(calledName);\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        const line = content.substring(0, arrow.indexOf(name)).split('\\n').length;\n        functions.push({\n          name,\n          line,\n          isExported,\n          isAsync,\n          calls: [...new Set(calls)],\n          calledBy: [],\n          params: [],\n          returnType: undefined,\n          body: body.length > 200 ? body.substring(0, 200) + '...' : body,\n          startLine: line,\n          endLine: line + arrow.split('\\n').length,\n          exportSource: isExported ? 'self' : 'self',\n          exportModule: undefined,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ============================================\n  // 5.           "body": "{\n  let dot = 'digraph HybridGraph {\\n';\n  dot += '  rankdir=LR;\\n';\n  dot += '  node [shape=box, style=\"filled,rounded\"];\\n';\n  dot += '  splines=true;\\n';\n  dot += '  ranksep=1.5;\\n';\n  dot += '  nodesep=0.8;\\n\\n';\n\n  // Группируем модули по уровням\n  const nodesByLevel: Record<number, any[]> = {};\n  for (const module of report.modules) {\n    const level = module.level;\n    if (!nodesByLevel[level]) nodesByLevel[level] = [];\n    nodesByLevel[level].push(module);\n  }\n\n  // Создаем подграфы для каждого уровня\n  for (const level of Object.keys(nodesByLevel).sort((a, b) => parseInt(a) - parseInt(b))) {\n    const levelNum = parseInt(level);\n    dot += `  subgraph cluster_level_${levelNum} {\\n`;\n    dot += `    label=\"Уровень ${levelNum}\";\\n`;\n    dot += `    style=filled;\\n`;\n    dot += `    fillcolor=\"#1a1a2e\";\\n`;\n    dot += `    color=\"#4a4a6a\";\\n`;\n\n    for (const module of nodesByLevel[levelNum] || []) {\n      // Цвет в зависимости от типа модуля\n      const color =\n        module.type === 'vue'\n          ? '#4ade80'\n          : module.type === 'ts'\n            ? '#60a5fa'\n            : module.type === 'tsx'\n              ? '#a78bfa'\n              : '#fcd34d';\n\n      const isRoot = module.path === report.root;\n      const label = isRoot ? `⭐ ${module.name}` : module.name;\n\n      // Узел модуля\n      dot += `    \"${module.path}\" [fillcolor=\"${color}\", label=\"${label}\", penwidth=${isRoot ? 3 : 1}];\\n`;\n\n      // Узлы функций внутри модуля\n      for (const func of module.functions) {\n        const funcColor = func.isExported ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24';\n        const funcId = `${module.path}#${func.name}`;\n        const funcLabel = func.isExported ? `📤 ${func.name}` : func.name;\n\n        dot += `    \"${funcId}\" [fillcolor=\"${funcColor}\", shape=ellipse, label=\"${funcLabel}\", fontsize=10];\\n`;\n        dot += `    \"${module.path}\" -> \"${funcId}\" [style=dashed, color=\"#94a3b8\", penwidth=0.5];\\n`;\n\n        // Связи между функциями (вызовы)\n        for (const call of func.calls) {\n          const targetFunc = module.functions.find((f: HybridFunction) => f.name === call);\n          if (targetFunc) {\n            const targetId = `${module.path}#${targetFunc.name}`;\n            dot += `    \"${funcId}\" -> \"${targetId}\" [color=\"#ef4444\", penwidth=1.5, label=\"вызов\"];\\n`;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    dot += '  }\\n\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Связи между модулями (импорты)\n  for (const edge of report.graph.edges) {\n    const fromLevel = report.levels[edge.from] ?? 0;\n    const toLevel = report.levels[edge.to] ?? 0;\n    const color = toLevel > fromLevel ? '#3b82f6' : '#f59e0b';\n    const label = toLevel > fromLevel ? `↓ ур.${toLevel}` : `↺ цикл?`;\n    dot += `  \"${edge.from}\" -> \"${edge.to}\" [color=\"${color}\", label=\"${label}\", penwidth=${toLevel > fromLevel ? 1 : 2}];\\n`;\n  }\n\n  dot += '}\\n';\n  return dot;\n}",

}\n        .func-item .func-source.external { color: #f472b6; }\n        \n        .cycles-section {\n            background: #1e293b;\n            border-radius: 8px;\n            padding: 16px;\n            margin-top: 20px;\n            border: 1px solid #f87171;\n        }\n        .cycles-section h2 { color: #f87171; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 18px; }\n        .cycle-item { font-family: monospace; color: #fbbf24; margin: 4px 0; font-size: 13px; }\n        \n        .levels-section {\n            display: flex;\n            gap: 20px;\n            flex-wrap: wrap;\n            margin: 15px 0;\n            padding: 15px;\n            background: #1e293b;\n            border-radius: 8px;\n            border: 1px solid #334155;\n        }\n        .level-stat {\n            text-align: center;\n            padding: 8px 16px;\n            background: #0f172a;\n            border-radius: 6px;\n            border-left: 3px solid #60a5fa;\n        }\n        .level-stat .lvl { font-size: 12px; color: #94a3b8; }\n        .level-stat .count { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #e2e8f0; }\n        .level-stat .sub { font-size: 10px; color: #64748b; }\n        \n        .view-toggle {\n            display: flex;\n            gap: 8px;\n            margin: 10px 0;\n        }\n        .view-toggle button {\n            background: #334155;\n            border: none;\n            color: #e2e8f0;\n            padding: 6px 16px;\n            border-radius: 6px;\n            cursor: pointer;\n            font-size: 12px;\n            transition: background 0.2s;\n        }\n        .view-toggle button.active {\n            background: #60a5fa;\n            color: #0f172a;\n        }\n        \n        .coordinate-system {\n            background: #1e293b;\n            border-radius: 12px;\n            padding: 20px;\n            margin: 15px 0;\n            border: 1px solid #334155;\n            position: relative;\n            overflow: hidden;\n        }\n        .coordinate-system h3 {\n            color: #60a5fa;\n            margin-bottom: 15px;\n            font-size: 16px;\n        }\n        .coordinate-grid {\n            display: grid;\n            grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr 80px;\n            gap: 10px;\n            align-items: center;\n        }\n        .coordinate-axis {\n            text-align: center;\n            font-size: 12px;\n            color: #94a3b8;\n        }\n        .coordinate-axis .label {\n            font-weight: bold;\n            color: #60a5fa;\n        }\n        .coordinate-axis .arrow {\n            font-size: 20px;\n            color: #3b82f6;\n        }\n        .coordinate-axis .arrow.back { color: #f59e0b; }\n        \n        .coordinate-bar {\n            position: relative;\n            height: 40px;\n            background: #0f172a;\n            border-radius: 8px;\n            border: 1px solid #334155;\n            overflow: visible;\n        }\n        .coordinate-bar .level-marker {\n            position: absolute;\n            top: -8px;\n            width: 2px;\n            height: 56px;\n            background: #60a5fa;\n            transition: all 0.3s;\n        }\n        .coordinate-bar .level-marker .level-label {\n            position: absolute;\n            top: -22px;\n            left: 50%;\n            transform: translateX(-50%);\n            font-size: 10px;\n            color: #60a5fa;\n            white-space: nowrap;\n        }\n        .coordinate-bar .level-marker .module-name {\n            position: absolute;\n            bottom: -20px;\n            left: 50%;\n            transform: translateX(-50%);\n            font-size: 8px;\n            color: #94a3b8;\n            white-space: nowrap;\n            max-width: 80px;\n            overflow: hidden;\n            text-overflow: ellipsis;\n        }\n        .coordinate-bar .level-marker.root {\n            background: #fbbf24;\n            height: 64px;\n            top: -12px;\n        }\n        .coordinate-bar .level-marker.root .level-label { color: #fbbf24; }\n        .coordinate-bar .level-marker.current {\n            background: #22d3ee;\n            height: 64px;\n            top: -12px;\n            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.3);\n        }\n        .coordinate-bar .level-marker.current .level-label { color: #22d3ee; }\n        \n        .coordinate-legend {\n            display: flex;\n            gap: 20px;\n            justify-content: center;\n            margin-top: 15px;\n            font-size: 11px;\n        }\n        .coordinate-legend .legend-dot {\n            display: inline-block;\n            width: 12px;\n            height: 12px;\n            border-radius: 50%;\n            margin-right: 6px;\n        }\n        \n        .range-warning {\n            background: #fef3c7;\n            color: #92400e;\n            padding: 10px 15px;\n            border-radius: 8px;\n            margin: 10px 0;\n            font-size: 13px;\n            border-left: 4px solid #f59e0b;\n        }\n        \n        @media (max-width: 768px) {\n            .modules-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }\n            .stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }\n            .coordinate-grid { grid-template-columns: 60px 1fr 60px; }\n        }\n        \n        .functions-list::-webkit-scrollbar {\n            width: 4px;\n        }\n        .functions-list::-webkit-scrollbar-track {\n            background: transparent;\n        }\n        .functions-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {\n            background: #475569;\n            border-radius: 4px;\n        }\n    </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n    <div class=\"container\">\n        <div class=\"header\">\n            <h1>🔀 Гибридный отчет: Модули + Функции</h1>\n            <div class=\"root\">⭐ Точка входа: ${report.root}</div>\n            <div class=\"sub\">Сгенерировано: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}</div>\n            <div class=\"sub\">Глубина анализа: ${report.stats.maxDepth}</div>\n        </div>\n\n        ${\n          !isLevelInRange\n            ? `\n        <div class=\"range-warning\">\n            ⚠️ Внимание: Текущий уровень (${currentLevel}) выходит за пределы диапазона [${minLevel}, ${maxDepth}]\n        </div>\n        `\n            : ''\n        }\n\n        <div class=\"stats\">\n            <div class=\"stat-card\">\n                <div class=\"value\">${report.stats.totalModules}</div>\n                <div class=\"label\">📁 Модулей</div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"stat-card\">\n                <div class=\"value\">${report.stats.totalFunctions}</div>\n                <div class=\"label\">🔧 Функций</div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"stat-card\">\n                <div class=\"value ${report.stats.cycles > 0 ? 'error' : 'success'}\">${report.stats.cycles}</div>\n                <div class=\"label\">🔄 Циклов</div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"stat-card\">\n                <div class=\"value\">${report.stats.totalComponents}</div>\n                <div class=\"label\">🧩 Компонентов</div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"stat-card\">\n                <div class=\"value\">${report.stats.totalComposables}</div>\n                <div class=\"label\">🧬 Композаблов</div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"stat-card\">\n                <div class=\"value\">${report.stats.totalExports}</div>\n                <div class=\"label\">📤 Экспортов</div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"stat-card\">\n                <div class=\"value\">${report.stats.totalImports}</div>\n                <div class=\"label\">📥 Импортов</div>\n            </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"levels-section\">\n            ${Object.entries(report.stats.byLevel)\n              .sort((a, b) => parseInt(a[0]) - parseInt(b[0]))\n              .map(\n                ([level, data]) => `\n                <div class=\"level-stat\">\n                    <div class=\"lvl\">Уровень ${level}</div>\n                    <div class=\"count\">${data.modules}</div>\n                    <div class=\"sub\">модулей, ${data.functions} функций</div>\n                </div>\n            `\n              )\n              .join('')}\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"coordinate-system\">\n            <h3>📊 3D Координатная система: Уровни и направления</h3>\n            <p style=\"font-size:12px;color:#94a3b8;margin-bottom:15px;\">\n                Максимальная глубина: ${maxDepth} | Минимальный уровень: 0 | Текущий уровень: ${currentLevel} ${isLevelInRange ? '✅ в диапазоне' : '⚠️ вне диапазона'}\n            </p>\n            <div class=\"coordinate-grid\">\n                <div class=\"coordinate-axis\">\n                    <div class=\"arrow back\">⬅️</div>\n                    <div class=\"label\">Назад</div>\n                    <div style=\"font-size:10px;color:#64748b;\">(уровень ↓)</div>\n                </div>\n                <div class=\"coordinate-bar\" id=\"coordinateBar\">\n                    ${(() => {\n                      const sortedModules = [...filteredModules].sort((a, b) => a.level - b.level);\n                      const currentPath = report.root;\n                      const rng = range;\n\n                      let markers = '';\n                      for (const module of sortedModules) {\n                        const pos = ((module.level - minLevel) / rng) * 100;\n                        const isRoot = module.path === report.root;\n                        const isCurrent = module.path === currentPath;\n                        let cls = '';\n                        if (isRoot) cls = 'root';\n                        else if (isCurrent) cls = 'current';\n                        const label = isRoot ? '⭐ ' + module.name : module.name;\n\n                        markers +=\n                          '<div class=\"level-marker ' + cls + '\" style=\"left: ' + pos + '%;\">';\n                        markers += '<div class=\"level-label\">' + module.level + '</div>';\n                        markers += '<div class=\"module-name\">' + label + '</div>';\n                        markers += '</div>';\n                      }\n                      return markers;\n                    })()}\n                </div>\n                <div class=\"coordinate-axis\">\n                    <div class=\"arrow\">➡️</div>\n                    <div class=\"label\">Вперед</div>\n                    <div style=\"font-size:10px;color:#64748b;\">(уровень ↑)</div>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"coordinate-legend\">\n                <span><span class=\"legend-dot\" style=\"background:#fbbf24;\"></span> Точка входа (уровень 0)</span>\n                <span><span class=\"legend-dot\" style=\"background:#60a5fa;\"></span> Модуль</span>\n                <span><span class=\"legend-dot\" style=\"background:#22d3ee;\"></span> Текущий модуль</span>\n                <span style=\"color:#3b82f6;\">➡️ Вперед (уровень ↑)</span>\n                <span style=\"color:#f59e0b;\">⬅️ Назад (уровень ↓)</span>\n            </div>\n            <div style=\"margin-top:10px;font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;text-align:center;\">\n                🔄 Движение вперед = импорт модуля с большим уровнем (глубина ↑) | Назад = импорт с меньшим уровнем (возврат ↑)\n            </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"legend\">\n            <div class=\"legend-item\">\n                <div class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#4ade80;\"></div>\n                <span>Vue компонент</span>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"legend-item\">\n                <div class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#60a5fa;\"></div>\n                <span>TypeScript модуль</span>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"legend-item\">\n                <div class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#fcd34d;\"></div>\n                <span>JavaScript модуль</span>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"legend-item\">\n                <div class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#f87171;\"></div>\n                <span>Экспортированная функция</span>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"legend-item\">\n                <div class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#fbbf24;\"></div>\n                <span>Внутренняя функция</span>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"legend-item\">\n                <div class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#3b82f6; width:30px; height:4px;\"></div>\n                <span>Импорт (вперед ↓)</span>\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"legend-item\">\n                <div class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background:#f59e0b; width:30px; height:4px;\"></div>\n                <span>Обратная связь (назад ↑)</span>\n            </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"view-toggle\">\n            <button class=\"active\" onclick=\"switchView('d3')\">📊 D3 Граф</button>\n            <button onclick=\"switchView('svg')\">📈 SVG (Graphviz)</button>\n            <button onclick=\"switchView('list')\">📋 Список</button>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"graph-container\">\n            <div id=\"d3-graph\" style=\"width:100%; height:700px; background:#0f172a; border-radius:8px; display:block;\"></div>\n            <div id=\"svg-graph\" style=\"width:100%; min-height:500px; background:#0f172a; border-radius:8px; display:none;\">\n                ${svgContent || '<p style=\"color:#94a3b8; text-align:center; padding:40px;\">SVG не доступен (Graphviz не установлен)</p>'}\n            </div>\n            <div id=\"list-view\" style=\"display:none; padding:20px; max-height:700px; overflow-y:auto;\">\n                <h3 style=\"color:#60a5fa;\">📋 Список связей</h3>\n                ${filteredModules\n                  .map(\n                    (m: HybridModule) => `\n                    <div style=\"margin:10px 0; padding:10px; background:#0f172a; border-radius:6px; border-left:3px solid ${m.level === 0 ? '#fbbf24' : '#60a5fa'};\">\n                        <div style=\"font-weight:bold; color:#e2e8f0;\">\n                            ${m.level === 0 ? '⭐ ' : ''}${m.name}\n                            <span style=\"font-size:10px; color:#64748b;\">(ур.${m.level})</span>\n                        </div>\n                        <div style=\"font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; margin-top:4px;\">\n                            ${m.functions.length} функций\n                            ${m.exports.length > 0 ? `, ${m.exports.length} экспортов` : ''}\n                            ${m.imports.length > 0 ? `, ${m.imports.length} импортов` : ''}\n                        </div>\n                        ${\n                          m.functions.length > 0\n                            ? `\n                            <div style=\"font-size:10px; color:#94a3b8; margin-top:4px;\">\n                                ${m.functions.map((f: HybridFunction) => `${f.name}${f.isExported ? '📤' : ''}${f.calls.length > 0 ? '→' + f.calls.join(',') : ''}`).join(' | ')}\n                            </div>\n                        `\n                            : ''\n                        }\n                    </div>\n                `\n                  )\n                  .join('')}\n            </div>\n            <div class=\"graph-controls\">\n                <button onclick=\"zoomIn()\">🔍+</button>\n                <button onclick=\"zoomOut()\">🔍−</button>\n                <button onclick=\"resetZoom()\">⟲ Сброс</button>\n                <button onclick=\"toggleLabels()\">🏷️ Метки</button>\n                <button onclick=\"toggleCycles()\">🔄 Циклы</button>\n            </div>\n        </div>\n\n        ${\n          report.cycles.length > 0\n            ? `\n        <div class=\"cycles-section\">\n            <h2>🔄 Циклические зависимости (${report.cycles.length})</h2>\n            ${report.cycles.map((cycle: string[]) => `<div class=\"cycle-item\">${cycle.join(' → ')}</div>`).join('')}\n        </div>\n        `\n            : ''\n        }\n\n        <h2 style=\"margin: 25px 0 15px; color:#60a5fa;\">📁 Модули по уровням</h2>\n        <div class=\"modules-grid\">\n            ${filteredModules\n              .map(\n                (module: HybridModule) => `\n            <div class=\"module-card\">\n                <span class=\"level-badge\">Ур. ${module.level}</span>\n                <div class=\"name\">${module.path === report.root ? '⭐ ' : ''}${module.name}</div>\n                <div class=\"path\">${module.path}</div>\n                <div class=\"badges\">\n                    <span class=\"badge function\">${module.functions.length} функций</span>\n                    ${module.exports.length > 0 ? `<span class=\"badge export\">${module.exports.length} экспортов</span>` : ''}\n                    ${module.imports.length > 0 ? `<span class=\"badge import\">${module.imports.length} импортов</span>` : ''}\n                    ${module.components.length > 0 ? `<span class=\"badge component\">${module.components.length} компонентов</span>` : ''}\n                    ${module.composables.length > 0 ? `<span class=\"badge composable\">${module.composables.length} композаблов</span>` : ''}\n                    <span class=\"badge level\">Уровень ${module.level}</span>\n                </div>\n                ${\n                  module.functions.length > 0\n                    ? `\n                <div class=\"functions-list\">\n                    ${module.functions\n                      .map(\n                        (f: HybridFunction) => `\n                        <div class=\"func-item\">\n                            <span class=\"func-name\">${f.name}</span>\n                            ${f.isExported ? '<span class=\"func-export\">📤</span>' : ''}\n                            ${f.isAsync ? '<span class=\"func-async\">⚡</span>' : ''}\n                            ${f.calls.length > 0 ? `<span class=\"func-calls\">→ ${f.calls.join(', ')}</span>` : ''}\n                            <span class=\"func-source ${f.exportSource}\">\n                                ${f.exportSource === 'self' ? '🔹 self' : f.exportSource === 'external' ? `🔸 ${f.exportModule}` : '🔄 re-export'}\n                            </span>\n                            <span style=\"font-size:9px; color:#64748b;\">строки ${f.startLine}-${f.endLine}</span>\n                        </div>\n                    `\n                      )\n                      .join('')}\n                </div>\n                `\n                    : '<div style=\"color:#64748b; font-size:12px; margin-top:8px;\">Нет функций</div>'\n                }\n            </div>\n            `\n              )\n              .join('')}\n        </div>\n    </div>\n\n    <script>\n        const graphData = ${jsonData};\n        let currentZoom = 1;\n        let showLabels = true;\n        let showCycles = true;\n        let svg, g, zoom;\n        let currentView = 'd3';\n\n        window.switchView = function(view) {\n            currentView = view;\n            document.getElementById('d3-graph').style.display = view === 'd3' ? 'block' : 'none';\n            document.getElementById('svg-graph').style.display = view === 'svg' ? 'block' : 'none';\n            document.getElementById('list-view').style.display = view === 'list' ? 'block' : 'none';\n            \n            document.querySelectorAll('.view-toggle button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));\n            document.querySelectorAll('.view-toggle button').forEach(b => {\n                if ((view === 'd3' && b.textContent.includes('D3')) ||\n                    (view === 'svg' && b.textContent.includes('SVG')) ||\n                    (view === 'list' && b.textContent.includes('Список'))) {\n                    b.classList.add('active');\n                }\n            });\n            \n            if (view === 'd3' && !document.querySelector('#d3-graph svg')) {\n                initGraph();\n            }\n        };\n\n        function initGraph() {\n            const width = document.getElementById('d3-graph').clientWidth || 900;\n            const height = 700;\n            \n            const container = d3.select('#d3-graph');\n            container.html('');\n            \n            svg = container.append('svg')\n                .attr('width', width)\n                .attr('height', height)\n                .style('background', '#0f172a')\n                .style('border-radius', '8px');\n            \n            const levelColors = ['#4ade80', '#60a5fa', '#a78bfa', '#f472b6', '#fbbf24', '#f87171', '#22d3ee'];\n            \n            const nodes: any[] = [];\n            const edges: any[] = [];\n            const nodeIds = new Set<string>();\n            \n            graphData.modules.forEach((module: HybridModule) => {\n                const id = module.path;\n                if (!nodeIds.has(id)) {\n                    nodeIds.add(id);\n                    const isRoot = module.path === graphData.root;\n                    nodes.push({\n                        id: id,\n                        name: isRoot ? '⭐ ' + module.name : module.name,\n                        type: module.type,\n                        level: module.level,\n                        isRoot: isRoot,\n                        functions: module.functions.length,\n                        exports: module.exports.length,\n                        imports: module.imports.length,\n                        color: levelColors[module.level % levelColors.length] || '#94a3b8',\n                        size: isRoot ? 35 : 25,\n                    });\n                }\n                \n                module.functions.forEach((func: HybridFunction) => {\n                    const funcId = id + '#func:' + func.name;\n                    if (!nodeIds.has(funcId)) {\n                        nodeIds.add(funcId);\n                        nodes.push({\n                            id: funcId,\n                            name: func.isExported ? '📤 ' + func.name : func.name,\n                            type: 'function',\n                            level: module.level,\n                            isRoot: false,\n                            isExported: func.isExported,\n                            isAsync: func.isAsync,\n                            calls: func.calls,\n                            parent: id,\n                            color: func.isExported ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24',\n                            size: 8,\n                        });\n                    }\n                });\n            });\n            \n            graphData.graph.edges.forEach((edge: { from: string; to: string; type: string; level?: number }) => {\n                const fromLevel = graphData.levels[edge.from] || 0;\n                const toLevel = graphData.levels[edge.to] || 0;\n                edges.push({\n                    source: edge.from,\n                    target: edge.to,\n                    type: edge.type,\n                    level: edge.level,\n                    fromLevel: fromLevel,\n                    toLevel: toLevel,\n                    isCycle: fromLevel > toLevel,\n                });\n            });\n            \n            graphData.modules.forEach((module: HybridModule) => {\n                module.functions.forEach((func: HybridFunction) => {\n                    func.calls.forEach((call: string) => {\n                        const targetFunc = module.functions.find((f: HybridFunction) => f.name === call);\n                        if (targetFunc) {\n                            edges.push({\n                                source: module.path + '#func:' + func.name,\n                                target: module.path + '#func:' + targetFunc.name,\n                                type: 'call',\n                                isCall: true,\n                            });\n                        }\n                    });\n                });\n            });\n            \n            zoom = d3.zoom()\n                .extent([[0, 0], [width, height]])\n                .scaleExtent([0.1, 4])\n                .on('zoom', (event: any) => {\n                    g.attr('transform', event.transform);\n                    currentZoom = event.transform.k;\n                });\n            \n            svg.call(zoom);\n            \n            g = svg.append('g');\n            \n            const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)\n                .force('link', d3.forceLink(edges).id((d: any) => d.id).distance(150))\n                .force('charge', d3.forceManyBody().strength(-300))\n                .force('center', d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))\n                .force('collision', d3.forceCollide().radius(30))\n                .force('x', d3.forceX(width / 2).strength(0.05))\n                .force('y', d3.forceY(height / 2).strength(0.05));\n            \n            const link = g.append('g')\n                .selectAll('line')\n                .data(edges)\n                .enter()\n                .append('line')\n                .attr('stroke', (d: any) => d.isCall ? '#ef4444' : (d.isCycle ? '#f59e0b' : '#3b82f6'))\n                .attr('stroke-width', (d: any) => d.isCall ? 1.5 : (d.isCycle ? 2 : 1))\n                .attr('stroke-opacity', (d: any) => d.isCall ? 0.8 : 0.5)\n                .attr('stroke-dasharray', (d: any) => d.isCall ? 'none' : (d.isCycle ? '8,4' : 'none'))\n                .attr('class', (d: any) => d.isCycle ? 'cycle-edge' : '');\n            \n            const node = g.append('g')\n                .selectAll('circle')\n                .data(nodes)\n                .enter()\n                .append('circle')\n                .attr('r', (d: any) => d.size || 10)\n                .attr('fill', (d: any) => d.color)\n                .attr('stroke', (d: any) => d.isRoot ? '#fbbf24' : '#1e293b')\n                .attr('stroke-width', (d: any) => d.isRoot ? 3 : 1)\n                .call(d3.drag()\n                    .on('start', dragstarted)\n                    .on('drag', dragged)\n                    .on('end', dragended));\n            \n            const label = g.append('g')\n                .selectAll('text')\n                .data(nodes)\n                .enter()\n                .append('text')\n                .text((d: any) => d.name)\n                .attr('font-size', (d: any) => d.type === 'function' ? '8px' : '11px')\n                .attr('fill', '#e2e8f0')\n                .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')\n                .attr('dy', (d: any) => d.type === 'function' ? -14 : 35)\n                .style('font-family', 'monospace')\n                .style('pointer-events', 'none');\n            \n            const info = g.append('g')\n                .selectAll('text.info')\n                .data(nodes.filter((d: any) => d.type !== 'function'))\n                .enter()\n                .append('text')\n                .text((d: any) => d.functions + ' функций')\n                .attr('font-size', '7px')\n                .attr('fill', '#94a3b8')\n                .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')\n                .attr('dy', 48)\n                .style('pointer-events', 'none');\n            \n            function ticked() {\n                link\n                    .attr('x1', (d: any) => d.source.x)\n                    .attr('y1', (d: any) => d.source.y)\n                    .attr('x2', (d: any) => d.target.x)\n                    .attr('y2', (d: any) => d.target.y);\n                \n                node\n                    .attr('cx', (d: any) => d.x)\n                    .attr('cy', (d: any) => d.y);\n                \n                label\n                    .attr('x', (d: any) => d.x)\n                    .attr('y', (d: any) => d.y);\n                \n                info\n                    .attr('x', (d: any) => d.x)\n                    .attr('y', (d: any) => d.y);\n            }\n            \n            simulation.on('tick', ticked);\n            \n            function dragstarted(event: any, d: any) {\n                if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();\n                d.fx = d.x;\n                d.fy = d.y;\n            }\n            \n            function dragged(event: any, d: any) {\n                d.fx = event.x;\n                d.fy = event.y;\n            }\n            \n            function dragended(event: any, d: any) {\n                if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);\n                d.fx = null;\n                d.fy = null;\n            }\n            \n            window.zoomIn = function() {\n                zoom.scaleBy(svg.transition().duration(300), 1.3);\n            };\n            \n            window.zoomOut = function() {\n                zoom.scaleBy(svg.transition().duration(300), 0.7);\n            };\n            \n            window.resetZoom = function() {\n                svg.transition().duration(500).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity);\n            };\n            \n            window.toggleLabels = function() {\n                showLabels = !showLabels;\n                label.style('display', showLabels ? 'block' : 'none');\n                info.style('display', showLabels ? 'block' : 'none');\n            };\n            \n            window.toggleCycles = function() {\n                showCycles = !showCycles;\n                document.querySelectorAll('.cycle-edge').forEach((el: Element) => {\n                    (el as HTMLElement).style.display = showCycles ? 'block' : 'none';\n                });\n                const cyclesSection = document.querySelector('.cycles-section');\n                if (cyclesSection) {\n                    (cyclesSection as HTMLElement).style.display = showCycles ? 'block' : 'none';\n                }\n            };\n        }\n        \n        window.addEventListener('load', function() {\n            initGraph();\n            const svgGraph = document.getElementById('svg-graph');\n            if (svgGraph) {\n                const svgEl = svgGraph.querySelector('svg');\n                if (svgEl) {\n                    svgPanZoom(svgEl, {\n                        zoomEnabled: true,\n                        controlIconsEnabled: true,\n                        fit: true,\n                        center: true,\n                        minZoom: 0.1,\n                        maxZoom: 4,\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        });\n        \n        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {\n            const container = document.getElementById('d3-graph');\n            if (container && currentView === 'd3') {\n                const width = container.clientWidth || 900;\n                const svgEl = container.querySelector('svg');\n                if (svgEl) {\n                    svgEl.setAttribute('width', width);\n                }\n            }\n        });\n    </script>\n</body>\n</html>`;\n}",

      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "generateHybridMarkdown",
          "line": 10,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "report"
          ],
          "returnType": "string",
          "calls": [
            "parseInt"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  let md = '# 🔀 ГИБРИДНЫЙ ОТЧЕТ: МОДУЛИ + ФУНКЦИИ\\n\\n';\n\n  md += `**Точка входа:** \\`${report.root}\\`\\n`;\n  md += `**Дата:** ${new Date().toLocaleString()}\\n\\n`;\n\n  // ============================================\n  // СТАТИСТИКА\n  // ============================================\n  md += '## 📊 СТАТИСТИКА\\n\\n';\n  md += '| Показатель | Значение |\\n';\n  md += '|------------|----------|\\n';\n  md += `| Модулей | ${report.stats.totalModules} |\\n`;\n  md += `| Функций | ${report.stats.totalFunctions} |\\n`;\n  md += `| Экспортов | ${report.stats.totalExports} |\\n`;\n  md += `| Импортов | ${report.stats.totalImports} |\\n`;\n  md += `| Компонентов | ${report.stats.totalComponents} |\\n`;\n  md += `| Композаблов | ${report.stats.totalComposables} |\\n`;\n  md += `| Циклов | ${report.stats.cycles} |\\n`;\n  md += `| Глубина | ${report.stats.maxDepth} |\\n\\n`;\n\n  // ============================================\n  // СТАТИСТИКА ПО УРОВНЯМ\n  // ============================================\n  md += '### По уровням\\n\\n';\n  md += '| Уровень | Модулей | Функций |\\n';\n  md += '|---------|---------|---------|\\n';\n\n  const sortedLevels = Object.entries(report.stats.byLevel).sort(\n    (a, b) => parseInt(a[0]) - parseInt(b[0])\n  );\n\n  for (const [level, data] of sortedLevels) {\n    md += `| ${level} | ${data.modules} | ${data.functions} |\\n`;\n  }\n  md += '\\n';\n\n  // ============================================\n  // МОДУЛИ\n  // ============================================\n  md += '## 📁 МОДУЛИ\\n\\n';\n\n  // Сортируем модули по уровню\n  const sortedModules = [...report.modules].sort((a, b) => a.level - b.level);\n\n  for (const module of sortedModules) {\n    const isRoot = module.path === report.root;\n    md += `### ${isRoot ? '⭐ ' : ''}${module.name}\\n`;\n    md += `**Путь:** \\`${module.path}\\`\\n`;\n    md += `**Тип:** ${module.type}\\n`;\n    md += `**Уровень:** ${module.level}\\n\\n`;\n\n    // Экспорты\n    if (module.exports.length > 0) {\n      md += '**Экспорты:**\\n';\n      for (const exp of module.exports) {\n        md += `- \\`${exp}\\`\\n`;\n      }\n      md += '\\n';\n    }\n\n    // Импорты\n    if (module.imports.length > 0) {\n      md += '**Импорты:**\\n';\n      for (const imp of module.imports) {\n        md += `- \\`${imp}\\`\\n`;\n      }\n      md += '\\n';\n    }\n\n    // Функции\n    if (module.functions.length > 0) {\n      md += '**Функции:**\\n';\n\n      // Сортируем функции: сначала экспортированные, затем внутренние\n      const sortedFunctions = [...module.functions].sort((a, b) => {\n        if (a.isExported && !b.isExported) return -1;\n        if (!a.isExported && b.isExported) return 1;\n        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);\n      });\n\n      for (const func of sortedFunctions) {\n        const exported = func.isExported ? ' 📤' : '';\n        const async = func.isAsync ? ' ⚡' : '';\n        const calls = func.calls.length > 0 ? ` → ${func.calls.join(', ')}` : '';\n        const source =\n          func.exportSource === 'self'\n            ? ' (self)'\n            : func.exportSource === 'external'\n              ? ` (from ${func.exportModule})`\n              : ' (re-export)';\n\n        md += `- \\`${func.name}\\`${exported}${async}${calls}${source}\\n`;\n        md += `  - Строки: ${func.startLine}-${func.endLine}\\n`;\n        md += `  - Параметры: ${func.params.length > 0 ? func.params.join(', ') : 'нет'}\\n`;\n\n        if (func.body && func.body.length > 0) {\n          const bodyPreview =\n            func.body.length > 100 ? func.body.substring(0, 100) + '...' : func.body;\n          md += `  - Тело: \\`${bodyPreview}\\`\\n`;\n        }\n      }\n      md += '\\n';\n    }\n\n    // Компоненты (Vue/React)\n    if (module.components.length > 0) {\n      md += '**Компоненты:**\\n';\n      for (const comp of module.components) {\n        md += `- \\`${comp}\\`\\n`;\n      }\n      md += '\\n';\n    }\n\n    // Композаблы (Vue composables)\n    if (module.composables.length > 0) {\n      md += '**Композаблы:**\\n';\n      for (const comp of module.composables) {\n        md += `- \\`${comp}\\`\\n`;\n      }\n      md += '\\n';\n    }\n\n    md += '---\\n\\n';\n  }\n\n  // ============================================\n  // ЦИКЛИЧЕСКИЕ ЗАВИСИМОСТИ\n  // ============================================\n  if (report.cycles.length > 0) {\n    md += '## 🔄 ЦИКЛИЧЕСКИЕ ЗАВИСИМОСТИ\\n\\n';\n    md += `Обнаружено **${report.cycles.length}** циклических зависимостей:\\n\\n`;\n\n    for (const cycle of report.cycles) {\n      md += `- ${cycle.join(' → ')}\\n`;\n    }\n    md += '\\n';\n\n    md += '### ⚠️ Рекомендации по устранению циклов\\n\\n';\n    md += '1. **Выделите общий код** в отдельный модуль\\n';\n    md += '2. **Используйте Dependency Injection** вместо прямых зависимостей\\n';\n    md += '3. **Внедрите интерфейсы** для разрыва жестких связей\\n';\n    md += '4. **Пересмотрите архитектуру** - возможно, модули должны быть на одном уровне\\n';\n  }\n\n  // ============================================\n  // ВЕРСИЯ И ПОДПИСЬ\n  // ============================================\n  md += '---\\n\\n';\n  md += `*Сгенерировано AST Analyzer Hybrid Report v3.0.0*\\n`;\n  md += `*Время генерации: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}*\\n`;\n\n  return md;\n}",

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  if (!report || !report.packages) return report;\n\n  const sanitized = { ...report };\n  sanitized.packages = {};\n\n  for (const [modulePath, pkg] of Object.entries(report.packages)) {\n    if (!pkg || typeof pkg !== 'object') {\n      sanitized.packages[modulePath] = pkg;\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    const entities = (pkg as any).entities || {};\n\n    sanitized.packages[modulePath] = {\n      ...pkg,\n      entities: {\n        functions: filterRealObjects(ensureArray(entities.functions)),\n        constants: filterRealObjects(ensureArray(entities.constants)),\n        variables: filterRealObjects(ensureArray(entities.variables)),\n        interfaces: filterRealObjects(ensureArray(entities.interfaces)),\n        types: filterRealObjects(ensureArray(entities.types)),\n        classes: filterRealObjects(ensureArray(entities.classes)),\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  return sanitized;\n}",

          "name": "safeTraverseAST",
          "line": 134,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "node",

          "returnType": "any",
          "calls": [
            "shouldSkipKey"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  // Базовые случаи\n  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return node;\n\n  // Защита от циклических ссылок\n  if (visited.has(node)) {\n    return '[Circular]';\n  }\n  visited.add(node);\n\n  // Ограничение глубины\n  const MAX_DEPTH = 50;\n  if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) {\n    return '[Max Depth]';\n  }\n\n  // Обработка массивов\n  if (Array.isArray(node)) {\n    return node.map((item: any) => safeTraverseAST(item, depth + 1, visited));\n  }\n\n  // Обработка объектов\n  if (node.constructor && node.constructor.name === 'Object') {\n    const result: Record<string, any> = {};\n    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n      // Пропускаем внутренние/несериализуемые свойства\n      if (shouldSkipKey(key)) {\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const value = node[key];\n      if (typeof value === 'function') {\n        result[key] = '[Function]';\n      } else if (value && typeof value === 'object') {\n        result[key] = safeTraverseAST(value, depth + 1, visited);\n      } else {\n        result[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  // Обработка других объектов (Date, RegExp, Map, Set и т.д.)\n  try {\n    if (node.toString && node.toString() !== '[object Object]') {\n      return node.toString();\n    }\n\n    // Для объектов без понятного toString, пытаемся извлечь свойства\n    const result: Record<string, any> = {};\n    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n      if (shouldSkipKey(key)) continue;\n\n      try {\n        const value = node[key];\n        if (typeof value === 'function') {\n          result[key] = '[Function]';\n        } else if (value && typeof value === 'object') {\n          result[key] = safeTraverseAST(value, depth + 1, visited);\n        } else {\n          result[key] = value;\n        }\n      } catch {\n        result[key] = '[Error]';\n      }\n    }\n    return Object.keys(result).length > 0 ? result : '[Object]';\n  } catch {\n    return '[Object]';\n  }\n}",

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const fileName = path.basename(filePath);\n\n  // Проверяем основные пути\n  const candidates = [\n    path.resolve(projectRoot, filePath),\n    path.resolve(projectRoot, 'src', filePath),\n    path.resolve(projectRoot, 'packages/ast-analyzer/src', filePath),\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), filePath),\n    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'src', filePath),\n  ];\n\n  for (const candidate of candidates) {\n    if (fs.existsSync(candidate) && fs.statSync(candidate).isFile()) {\n      return candidate;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Рекурсивный поиск по имени файла в src\n  const srcDir = path.resolve(projectRoot, 'src');\n  if (fs.existsSync(srcDir)) {\n    const walkDir = (dir: string): string | null => {\n      try {\n        const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);\n        for (const file of files) {\n          const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);\n          if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {\n            const result = walkDir(fullPath);\n            if (result) return result;\n          } else if (file === fileName) {\n            return fullPath;\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // Игнорируем ошибки\n      }\n      return null;\n    };\n\n    const foundPath = walkDir(srcDir);\n    if (foundPath) {\n      return foundPath;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  let totalFunctions = 0;\n  let totalConstants = 0;\n  let totalVariables = 0;\n  let totalInterfaces = 0;\n  let totalTypes = 0;\n  let totalClasses = 0;\n  let totalCalls = 0;\n  let totalExportedFunctions = 0;\n  let totalAsyncFunctions = 0;\n\n  for (const pkg of Object.values(packages)) {\n    totalFunctions += pkg.entities?.functions?.length || 0;\n    totalConstants += pkg.entities?.constants?.length || 0;\n    totalVariables += pkg.entities?.variables?.length || 0;\n    totalInterfaces += pkg.entities?.interfaces?.length || 0;\n    totalTypes += pkg.entities?.types?.length || 0;\n    totalClasses += pkg.entities?.classes?.length || 0;\n\n    for (const func of pkg.entities?.functions || []) {\n      if (func.isExported) totalExportedFunctions++;\n      if (func.isAsync) totalAsyncFunctions++;\n    }\n  }\n\n  for (const calls of Object.values(callGraph)) {\n    totalCalls += calls.length;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    totalFunctions,\n    totalConstants,\n    totalVariables,\n    totalInterfaces,\n    totalTypes,\n    totalClasses,\n    totalCalls,\n    totalExportedFunctions,\n    totalAsyncFunctions,\n  };\n}",

      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "buildDependencyGraph",
          "line": 10,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graph"
          ],
          "returnType": "import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/src/reporters/modules/graphs\").DependencyGraph",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const inwardDeps: Record<string, string[]> = {};\n  const outwardDeps: Record<string, string[]> = {};\n\n  // Инициализация структур для всех модулей\n  for (const modulePath of Object.keys(graph)) {\n    inwardDeps[modulePath] = [];\n    outwardDeps[modulePath] = [];\n  }\n\n  // Заполнение зависимостей\n  for (const [from, deps] of Object.entries(graph)) {\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      if (inwardDeps[from]) {\n        inwardDeps[from].push(dep);\n      }\n      if (outwardDeps[dep]) {\n        outwardDeps[dep].push(from);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    direction: 'bidirectional',\n    inwardDependencies: inwardDeps,\n    outwardDependencies: outwardDeps,\n  };\n}",
          "startLine": 10,
          "endLine": 37,
          "isMethod": false,
          "className": "",
          "isNested": false,
          "parentFunction": "",
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "eventType": "",
          "depth": 0,
          "complexity": 2,

        },
        {
          "name": "findCycles",
          "line": 42,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData"
          ],
          "returnType": "boolean",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n  const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n\n  const dfs = (node: string): boolean => {\n    if (recursionStack.has(node)) return true;\n    if (visited.has(node)) return false;\n\n    visited.add(node);\n    recursionStack.add(node);\n\n    const neighbors = graphData[node] || [];\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      if (dfs(neighbor)) return true;\n    }\n\n    recursionStack.delete(node);\n    return false;\n  };\n\n  for (const node of Object.keys(graphData)) {\n    if (dfs(node)) return true;\n  }\n  return false;\n}",
          "startLine": 42,
          "endLine": 66,
          "isMethod": false,
          "className": "",
          "isNested": false,
          "parentFunction": "",
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "eventType": "",
          "depth": 0,
          "complexity": 5,
          "security": {
            "hasEval": false,
            "hasProcessEnv": false,
            "hasSensitiveData": false,
            "hasExec": false,
            "hasPassword": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "findAllCycles",
          "line": 71,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData"
          ],
          "returnType": "string[][]",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const cycles: string[][] = [];\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n  const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n  const path: string[] = [];\n\n  const dfs = (node: string) => {\n    if (recursionStack.has(node)) {\n      // Найден цикл\n      const cycleStart = path.indexOf(node);\n      if (cycleStart !== -1) {\n        const cycle = path.slice(cycleStart);\n        // Добавляем замыкающее ребро\n        const fullCycle = [...cycle, node];\n        cycles.push(fullCycle);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (visited.has(node)) return;\n\n    visited.add(node);\n    recursionStack.add(node);\n    path.push(node);\n\n    const neighbors = graphData[node] || [];\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      dfs(neighbor);\n    }\n\n    recursionStack.delete(node);\n    path.pop();\n  };\n\n  for (const node of Object.keys(graphData)) {\n    if (!visited.has(node)) {\n      dfs(node);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return cycles;\n}",
          "startLine": 71,
          "endLine": 112,
          "isMethod": false,
          "className": "",
          "isNested": false,
          "parentFunction": "",
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "eventType": "",
          "depth": 0,
          "complexity": 2,
          "security": {
            "hasEval": false,
            "hasProcessEnv": false,
            "hasSensitiveData": false,
            "hasExec": false,
            "hasPassword": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "findCyclicEdges",
          "line": 117,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData"
          ],
          "returnType": "Set<string>",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const cyclicEdges = new Set<string>();\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n  const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n  const path: string[] = [];\n\n  const dfs = (node: string) => {\n    if (recursionStack.has(node)) {\n      const cycleStart = path.indexOf(node);\n      if (cycleStart !== -1) {\n        for (let i = cycleStart; i < path.length; i++) {\n          const from = path[i];\n          const to = i + 1 < path.length ? path[i + 1] : node;\n          if (from && to) {\n            cyclicEdges.add(`${from}->${to}`);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (visited.has(node)) return;\n\n    visited.add(node);\n    recursionStack.add(node);\n    path.push(node);\n\n    const neighbors = graphData[node] || [];\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      dfs(neighbor);\n    }\n\n    recursionStack.delete(node);\n    path.pop();\n  };\n\n  for (const node of Object.keys(graphData)) {\n    if (!visited.has(node)) {\n      dfs(node);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return cyclicEdges;\n}",
          "startLine": 117,
          "endLine": 160,
          "isMethod": false,
          "className": "",
          "isNested": false,
          "parentFunction": "",
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "eventType": "",
          "depth": 0,
          "complexity": 2,
          "security": {
            "hasEval": false,
            "hasProcessEnv": false,
            "hasSensitiveData": false,
            "hasExec": false,
            "hasPassword": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "getMaxDepth",
          "line": 165,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData"
          ],
          "returnType": "number",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  let max = 0;\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n\n  const dfs = (node: string, depth: number) => {\n    if (visited.has(node)) return;\n    visited.add(node);\n    max = Math.max(max, depth);\n\n    const neighbors = graphData[node] || [];\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      dfs(neighbor, depth + 1);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Находим корневые узлы (те, на которые никто не ссылается)\n  const called = new Set<string>();\n  for (const deps of Object.values(graphData)) {\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      called.add(dep);\n    }\n  }\n\n  const roots = Object.keys(graphData).filter((node: string) => !called.has(node));\n\n  // Если корневых узлов нет, значит есть циклы, берем все узлы\n  if (roots.length === 0) {\n    for (const node of Object.keys(graphData)) {\n      if (!visited.has(node)) {\n        dfs(node, 0);\n      }\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const root of roots) {\n      dfs(root, 0);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return max;\n}",
          "startLine": 165,
          "endLine": 204,
          "isMethod": false,
          "className": "",
          "isNested": false,
          "parentFunction": "",
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "eventType": "",
          "depth": 0,
          "complexity": 2,
          "security": {
            "hasEval": false,
            "hasProcessEnv": false,
            "hasSensitiveData": false,
            "hasExec": false,
            "hasPassword": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "getModulesByLevel",
          "line": 209,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "outwardDeps"
          ],
          "returnType": "Record<number, string[]>",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const modulesByLevel: Record<number, string[]> = {};\n  const queue: { node: string; level: number }[] = [];\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n\n  // Находим корневые узлы (те, на которые никто не ссылается)\n  const called = new Set<string>();\n  for (const deps of Object.values(outwardDeps)) {\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      called.add(dep);\n    }\n  }\n\n  const roots = Object.keys(outwardDeps).filter((node: string) => !called.has(node));\n\n  // Если корневых узлов нет, берем все узлы с уровнем 0\n  if (roots.length === 0) {\n    for (const node of Object.keys(outwardDeps)) {\n      queue.push({ node, level: 0 });\n    }\n  } else {\n    for (const root of roots) {\n      queue.push({ node: root, level: 0 });\n    }\n  }\n\n  while (queue.length > 0) {\n    const { node, level } = queue.shift()!;\n    if (visited.has(node)) continue;\n    visited.add(node);\n\n    if (!modulesByLevel[level]) {\n      modulesByLevel[level] = [];\n    }\n    modulesByLevel[level].push(node);\n\n    const deps = outwardDeps[node] || [];\n    for (const dep of deps) {\n      if (!visited.has(dep)) {\n        queue.push({ node: dep, level: level + 1 });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return modulesByLevel;\n}",
          "startLine": 209,
          "endLine": 254,
          "isMethod": false,
          "className": "",
          "isNested": false,
          "parentFunction": "",
          "isArrow": false,

        },
        {
          "name": "findPathBetweenNodes",
          "line": 259,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData",
            "from",
            "to"
          ],
          "returnType": "string[] | null",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  if (from === to) return [from];\n\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n  const queue: { node: string; path: string[] }[] = [{ node: from, path: [from] }];\n\n  while (queue.length > 0) {\n    const { node, path } = queue.shift()!;\n    if (visited.has(node)) continue;\n    visited.add(node);\n\n    const neighbors = graphData[node] || [];\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      if (neighbor === to) {\n        return [...path, neighbor];\n      }\n      if (!visited.has(neighbor)) {\n        queue.push({ node: neighbor, path: [...path, neighbor] });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}",
          "startLine": 259,
          "endLine": 286,
          "isMethod": false,
          "className": "",
          "isNested": false,
          "parentFunction": "",
          "isArrow": false,
          "isEventHandler": false,
          "eventType": "",
          "depth": 0,

            "hasExec": false,

          }
        },
        {
          "name": "findAllPathsBetweenNodes",
          "line": 291,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphData",
            "from",
            "to",
            "maxDepth"
          ],
          "returnType": "string[][]",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const paths: string[][] = [];\n\n  const dfs = (current: string, path: string[], depth: number) => {\n    if (depth > maxDepth) return;\n    if (path.includes(current)) return; // Предотвращаем циклы\n\n    const newPath = [...path, current];\n\n    if (current === to) {\n      paths.push(newPath);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const neighbors = graphData[current] || [];\n    for (const neighbor of neighbors) {\n      dfs(neighbor, newPath, depth + 1);\n    }\n  };\n\n  dfs(from, [], 0);\n  return paths;\n}",

            "graphData",

          "returnType": "string[]",
          "calls": [
            "dfs"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const dependents: string[] = [];\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n\n  const dfs = (current: string) => {\n    if (visited.has(current)) return;\n    visited.add(current);\n\n    for (const [caller, deps] of Object.entries(graphData)) {\n      if (deps.includes(current) && !visited.has(caller)) {\n        dependents.push(caller);\n        dfs(caller);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  dfs(node);\n  return dependents;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const cycles: { from: string; to: string; cyclePath?: string[]; moduleInfo?: string }[] = [];\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n  const recursionStack = new Set<string>();\n\n  // Используем graphData для быстрой проверки циклов\n  if (graphData && graphData.hasCycles) {\n    const cyclicEdges = graphData.cyclicEdges || [];\n    for (const edge of cyclicEdges) {\n      const parts = edge.split('->');\n      const from = parts[0] || '';\n      const to = parts[1] || '';\n      if (from && to) {\n        // Обогащаем информацию о цикле данными из packages\n        let moduleInfo = '';\n        if (packages && packages[from]) {\n          const pkg = packages[from];\n          moduleInfo = `${pkg.language || ''} ${pkg.type || ''}`.trim();\n        }\n\n        cycles.push({\n          from,\n          to,\n          cyclePath: [from, to],\n          moduleInfo: moduleInfo || undefined,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n    return cycles;\n  }\n\n  // Если в graphData нет информации о циклах, ищем самостоятельно\n  const dfs = (modulePath: string, path: string[]) => {\n    if (recursionStack.has(modulePath)) {\n      const cycleStart = path.indexOf(modulePath);\n      if (cycleStart !== -1) {\n        const cyclePath = path.slice(cycleStart);\n        for (let i = cycleStart;           "name": "buildCallGraphFromScript",
          "line": 8,

          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const callGraph: Record<string, string[]> = {};\n\n  if (!content || content.trim() === '') {\n    return callGraph;\n  }\n\n  const allNames = [\n    ...functions.map(f => f.name),\n    ...composables.map(c => c.name),\n  ];\n\n  // Инициализируем callGraph для всех функций\n  for (const name of allNames) {\n    if (name) {\n      callGraph[name] = [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Разбиваем код на строки\n  const lines = content.split('\\n');\n\n  // Строим карту: имя функции -> диапазон строк, где она определена\n  const functionRanges: Record<string, { startLine: number; endLine: number }> = {};\n\n  // Проходим по всем функциям и определяем их диапазон строк\n  for (const func of functions) {\n    const funcName = func.name;\n    if (!funcName) continue;\n\n    // Ищем строку с объявлением функции\n    let startLine = -1;\n    let endLine = -1;\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i];\n      if (!line) continue;\n\n      // Проверяем объявление функции\n      if (\n        line.includes(`function ${funcName}(`) ||\n        line.includes(`function ${funcName} (`) ||\n        line.includes(`const ${funcName} =`) ||\n        line.includes(`let ${funcName} =`)\n      ) {\n        startLine = i;\n\n        // Ищем конец функции (закрывающую скобку)\n        let braceCount = 0;\n        let foundOpenBrace = false;\n\n        for (let j = i; j < lines.length; j++) {\n          const currentLine = lines[j];\n          if (!currentLine) continue;\n\n          // Считаем открывающие и закрывающие скобки\n          for (let k = 0; k < currentLine.length; k++) {\n            const char = currentLine[k];\n            if (char === '{') {\n              braceCount++;\n              foundOpenBrace = true;\n            } else if (char === '}') {\n              braceCount--;\n              if (foundOpenBrace && braceCount === 0) {\n                endLine = j;\n                break;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n          if (endLine !== -1) break;\n        }\n\n        // Если не нашли конец, используем приблизительный диапазон\n        if (endLine === -1) {\n          endLine = Math.min(startLine + 20, lines.length - 1);\n        }\n\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Если нашли диапазон, сохраняем его\n    if (startLine !== -1 && endLine !== -1) {\n      functionRanges[funcName] = { startLine, endLine };\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Для каждой функции ищем вызовы внутри ее диапазона\n  for (const func of functions) {\n    const funcName = func.name;\n    if (!funcName) continue;\n\n    // Убеждаемся, что массив существует\n    if (!callGraph[funcName]) {\n      callGraph[funcName] = [];\n    }\n\n    const range = functionRanges[funcName];\n    if (!range) continue;\n\n    // Проверяем строки внутри диапазона функции\n    for (let i = range.startLine + 1; i <= range.endLine && i < lines.length; i++) {\n      const line = lines[i];\n      if (!line) continue;\n\n      // Ищем вызовы в строке\n      for (const calledName of allNames) {\n        if (!calledName || calledName === funcName) continue;\n\n        // Проверяем, есть ли вызов в строке\n        const callPattern = `${calledName}(`;\n        if (line.includes(callPattern)) {\n          // Проверяем, не является ли это объявлением\n          const trimmedLine = line.trim();\n          if (\n            !trimmedLine.startsWith('function') &&\n            !trimmedLine.startsWith('const') &&\n            !trimmedLine.startsWith('let') &&\n            !trimmedLine.startsWith('export')\n          ) {\n            if (!callGraph[funcName].includes(calledName)) {\n              callGraph[funcName].push(calledName);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return callGraph;\n}",

'...' : ''}\\` | ${c.isExported ? '✅' : '❌'} |\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Композаблы\n  if (analysis.composables.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 🧩 Composables (${analysis.composables.length})\\n\\n`;\n    for (const comp of analysis.composables) {\n      report += `- **${comp.name}** → переменная \\`${comp.source}\\`\\n`;\n      if (comp.args.length > 0) {\n        report += `  - Аргументы: ${comp.args.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Props\n  if (analysis.props.names.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 📥 Props (${analysis.props.names.length})\\n\\n`;\n    report += '| Имя | Тип | Обязательный | По умолчанию |\\n';\n    report += '|-----|-----|--------------|--------------|\\n';\n    for (const name of analysis.props.names) {\n      const type = analysis.props.types[name] || 'any';\n      const required = analysis.props.required[name] ? '✅' : '❌';\n      const defaultValue =\n        analysis.props.defaults[name] !== undefined ? String(analysis.props.defaults[name]) : '-';\n      report += `| \\`${name}\\` | \\`${type}\\` | ${required} | ${defaultValue} |\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Events\n  if (analysis.emits.names.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 📤 Events (${analysis.emits.names.length})\\n\\n`;\n    for (const name of analysis.emits.names) {\n      const typeInfo = analysis.emits.types[name] ? `: \\`${analysis.emits.types[name]}\\`` : '';\n      report += `- **${name}**${typeInfo}\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Slots\n  if (analysis.slots.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 🎭 Slots (${analysis.slots.length})\\n\\n`;\n    for (const slot of analysis.slots) {\n      report += `- \\`${slot}\\`\\n`;\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Типы\n  if (analysis.types.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 📝 Типы (${analysis.types.length})\\n\\n`;\n    for (const type of analysis.types) {\n      report += `- \\`${type.name}\\` = \\`${type.definition}\\`${type.isExported ? ' 📤' : ''}\\n`;\n      if (intf.extends && intf.extends.length > 0) {\n        report += `  extends: ${intf.extends.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n      if (intf.properties.length > 0) {\n        report += `  properties: ${intf.properties.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n    }\n    report += '\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Импорты\n  if (analysis.imports.length > 0) {\n    report += `## 📦 Импорты (${analysis.imports.length})\\n\\n`;\n    const externalImports = analysis.imports.filter(i => !i.source.startsWith('.'));\n    const internalImports = analysis.imports.filter(i => i.source.startsWith('.'));\n\n    if (externalImports.length > 0) {\n      report += '### Внешние зависимости\\n';\n      for (const imp of externalImports) {\n        report += `- \\`${imp.source}\\` → ${imp.specifiers.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n      report += '\\n';\n    }\n\n    if (internalImports.length > 0) {\n      report += '### Локальные модули\\n';\n      for (const imp of internalImports) {\n        report += `- \\`${imp.source}\\` → ${imp.specifiers.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n      report += '\\n';\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Граф вызовов\n  const hasCalls = Object.values(analysis.callGraph).some(arr => arr.length > 0);\n  if (hasCalls) {\n    report += `## 🔗 Граф вызовов\\n\\n`;\n    report += '```\\n';\n    for (const [caller, callees] of Object.entries(analysis.callGraph)) {\n      if (callees.length > 0) {\n        report += `${caller} → ${callees.join(', ')}\\n`;\n      }\n    }\n    report += '```\\n\\n';\n  }\n\n  // Рекомендации\n  report += '---\\n';\n  report += '## 💡 Рекомендации по разбиению\\n\\n';\n\n  if (analysis.template.complexity > 50) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Шаблон слишком большой** (${analysis.template.complexity} элементов). Рекомендуется вынести части в отдельные компоненты.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.props.names.length > 10) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Много props** (${analysis.props.names.length}). Возможно, компонент пытается делать слишком много.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.composables.length > 5) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Много composables** (${analysis.composables.length}). Рассмотрите группировку связанной логики.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  if (analysis.stats.scriptLines > 300) {\n    report += `⚠️ **Скрипт слишком большой** (${analysis.stats.scriptLines} строк). Разбейте на несколько composables.\\n\\n`;\n  }\n\n  report += '---\\n';\n\n  return report;\n}",

          "calls": [],

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return undefined;\n\n  if (node.type === 'Literal') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'Identifier') {\n    return node.name;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'StringLiteral') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n  if (node.type === 'NumericLiteral') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n  if (node.type === 'BooleanLiteral') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n  if (node.type === 'NullLiteral') {\n    return null;\n  }\n  if (node.type === 'RegExpLiteral') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n  if (node.type === 'BigIntLiteral') {\n    return node.value;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'TemplateLiteral') {\n    return node.quasis?.map((q: any) => q.value?.raw || '').join('');\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'UnaryExpression' && node.operator === '-') {\n    const arg = getNodeValue(node.argument);\n    if (typeof arg === 'number') return -arg;\n    return undefined;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ObjectExpression') {\n    const result: Record<string, any> = {};\n    if (node.properties) {\n      for (const prop of node.properties) {\n        if (prop.type === 'Property' && prop.key) {\n          const key = prop.key.name || prop.key.value;\n          if (key !== undefined) {\n            result[key] = getNodeValue(prop.value);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ArrayExpression') {\n    const result: any[] = [];\n    if (node.elements) {\n      for (const elem of node.elements) {\n        result.push(getNodeValue(elem));\n      }\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  if (node.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression' || node.type === 'FunctionExpression') {\n    return 'function';\n  }\n\n  return undefined;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  if (!node) return [];\n\n  const params: string[] = [];\n\n  if (node.params && Array.isArray(node.params)) {\n    for (const param of node.params) {\n      if (param.type === 'Identifier') {\n        params.push(param.name);\n      } else if (param.type === 'AssignmentPattern' && param.left) {\n        params.push(param.left.name);\n      } else if (param.type === 'RestElement' && param.argument) {\n        params.push(`...${param.argument.name}`);\n      } else if (param.type === 'ObjectPattern') {\n        if (param.properties) {\n          for (const prop of param.properties) {\n            if (prop.type === 'Property' && prop.key) {\n              params.push(prop.key.name);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } else if (param.type === 'ArrayPattern') {\n        if (param.elements) {\n          for (const elem of param.elements) {\n            if (elem && elem.type === 'Identifier') {\n              params.push(elem.name);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return params;\n}",

    "src/modes/vue-analyzer/extractors/imports.ts": {

          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const imports: VueComponentAnalysis['imports'] = [];\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return imports;\n\n  try {\n    for (const node of ast.body) {\n      if (node.type === 'ImportDeclaration' && node.source) {\n        const specifiers: string[] = [];\n        let isTypeOnly = false;\n\n        const importNode = node as any;\n        if (importNode.importKind === 'type') {\n          isTypeOnly = true;\n        }\n\n        for (const spec of node.specifiers) {\n          if (spec.type === 'ImportSpecifier') {\n            const importedName =\n              spec.imported.type === 'Identifier' ? spec.imported.name : spec.imported.value;\n            const localName = spec.local.name;\n            if (importedName === localName) {\n              specifiers.push(importedName);\n            } else {\n              specifiers.push(`${importedName} as ${localName}`);\n            }\n          } else if (spec.type === 'ImportDefaultSpecifier') {\n            specifiers.push(`default as ${spec.local.name}`);\n          } else if (spec.type === 'ImportNamespaceSpecifier') {\n            specifiers.push(`* as ${spec.local.name}`);\n          }\n        }\n\n        const sourceValue = node.source.value;\n        if (typeof sourceValue === 'string') {\n          imports.push({\n            source: sourceValue,\n            specifiers,\n            isTypeOnly,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    // Игнорируем ошибки\n  }\n\n  return imports;\n}",
