          "body": "{\n  const imports: VueComponentAnalysis['imports'] = [];\n\n  const importRegex =\n    /import\\s+(?:type\\s+)?(?:\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s+from\\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]|(\\w+)\\s+from\\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]|\\*\\s+as\\s+(\\w+)\\s+from\\s+['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"])/g;\n\n  let match;\n  while ((match = importRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {\n    if (match[1] && match[2]) {\n      // Named imports: import { a, b } from 'source'\n      const specifiers = match[1]\n        .split(',')\n        .map(s => s.trim())\n        .filter(s => s);\n      const source = match[2];\n      const isTypeOnly = content.includes(`import type { ${specifiers.join(', ')} }`);\n      if (source && specifiers.length > 0) {\n        imports.push({\n          source,\n          specifiers,\n          isTypeOnly,\n        });\n      }\n    } else if (match[3] && match[4]) {\n      // Default import: import something from 'source'\n      const source = match[4];\n      if (source) {\n        imports.push({\n          source: source,\n          specifiers: [`default as ${match[3]}`],\n          isTypeOnly: false,\n        });\n      }\n    } else if (match[5] && match[6]) {\n      // Namespace import: import * as something from 'source'\n      const source = match[6];\n      if (source) {\n        imports.push({\n          source: source,\n          specifiers: [`* as ${match[5]}`],\n          isTypeOnly: false,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return imports;\n}",

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const composables: VueComponentAnalysis['composables'] = [];\n\n  const vueComposables = ['ref', 'reactive', 'computed', 'watch', 'watchEffect'];\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return composables;\n\n  function visitNode(node: any) {\n    if (!node) return;\n\n    try {\n      if (node.type === 'VariableDeclaration') {\n        for (const decl of node.declarations) {\n          if (decl.init && decl.init.type === 'CallExpression') {\n            const callee = decl.init.callee;\n            let name: string | null = null;\n\n            if (callee.type === 'Identifier') {\n              name = callee.name;\n            } else if (\n              callee.type === 'MemberExpression' &&\n              callee.property.type === 'Identifier'\n            ) {\n              name = callee.property.name;\n            }\n\n            if (name && (name.startsWith('use') || vueComposables.includes(name))) {\n              const source = decl.id?.type === 'Identifier' ? decl.id.name : 'unknown';\n              const args = decl.init.arguments.map((arg: any) => {\n                if (arg.type === 'Literal') return String(arg.value);\n                if (arg.type === 'Identifier') return arg.name;\n                if (arg.type === 'ObjectExpression') return '{ ... }';\n                if (arg.type === 'ArrayExpression') return '[ ... ]';\n                return '...';\n              });\n\n              const exists = composables.some(c => c.name === name && c.source === source);\n              if (!exists) {\n                composables.push({ name, source, args });\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {\n        const child = node[key];\n        if (child && typeof child === 'object') {\n          visitNode(child);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Игнорируем ошибки\n    }\n  }\n\n  try {\n    visitNode(ast);\n  } catch (error) {\n    // Игнорируем ошибки\n  }\n\n  return composables;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const composables: VueComponentAnalysis['composables'] = [];\n\n  const vueComposables = [\n    'ref', 'reactive', 'computed', 'watch', 'watchEffect',\n    'provide', 'inject', 'useSlots', 'useAttrs', 'useModel',\n    'useRouter', 'useRoute', 'useStore', 'useI18n', 'useHead',\n    'useAsyncData', 'useFetch', 'useLazyFetch', 'useCookie',\n    'useRuntimeConfig', 'useAppConfig', 'useRequestHeaders',\n    'useRequestEvent', 'useRequestURL', 'useSanitizedCookie',\n    'useState', 'useHydration', 'useNuxtApp',\n  ];\n\n  const patterns = [\n    /const\\s+(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*(use\\w+|computed|ref|reactive|watch|watchEffect|provide|inject)\\(([^)]*)\\)/g,\n    /const\\s*\\{\\s*([^}]+)\\s*\\}\\s*=\\s*(use\\w+)\\(([^)]*)\\)/g,\n    /const\\s*\\[\\s*([^\\]]+)\\s*\\]\\s*=\\s*(use\\w+)\\(([^)]*)\\)/g,\n    /(use\\w+)\\(/g,\n  ];\n\n  for (const pattern of patterns) {\n    pattern.lastIndex = 0;\n    let match;\n    while ((match = pattern.exec(content)) !== null) {\n      let source: string;\n      let name: string;\n      let args: string[] = [];\n\n      const isDestructure = pattern.source.includes(\n        'const\\\\s*\\\\{\\\\s*([^}]+)\\\\s*\\\\}\\\\s*=\\\\s*(use\\\\w+)'\n      );\n      const isArray = pattern.source.includes('const\\\\s*\\\\[\\\\s*([^\\\\]]+)\\\\s*\\\\]\\\\s*=\\\\s*(use\\\\w+)');\n      const isDirectCall = pattern.source.includes('(use\\\\w+)\\\\(') && !pattern.source.includes('const');\n\n      if (isDestructure) {\n        source = match[1]?.trim() || 'unknown';\n        name = match[2] || 'unknown';\n        args = match[3]\n          ? match[3]\n            .split(',')\n            .map(a => a.trim())\n            .filter(a => a)\n          : [];\n      } else if (isArray) {\n        source = match[1]?.trim() || 'unknown';\n        name = match[2] || 'unknown';\n        args = match[3]\n          ? match[3]\n            .split(',')\n            .map(a => a.trim())\n            .filter(a => a)\n          : [];\n      } else if (isDirectCall) {\n        name = match[1] || 'unknown';\n        source = 'direct_call';\n        args = [];\n      } else {\n        source = match[1]?.trim() || 'unknown';\n        name = match[2] || 'unknown';\n        args = match[3]\n          ? match[3]\n            .split(',')\n            .map(a => a.trim())\n            .filter(a => a)\n          : [];\n      }\n\n      if (!name || name === 'unknown') continue;\n\n      if (name.startsWith('use') || vueComposables.includes(name)) {\n        const exists = composables.some(c => c.name === name && c.source === source);\n        if (!exists) {\n          composables.push({ name, source, args });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const destructurePattern = /const\\s*\\{\\s*([^}]+)\\s*\\}\\s*=\\s*(use\\w+)\\(/g;\n  destructurePattern.lastIndex = 0;\n  let destMatch;\n  while ((destMatch = destructurePattern.exec(content)) !== null) {\n    const source = destMatch[1]?.trim() || 'unknown';\n    const name = destMatch[2] || 'unknown';\n    if (name && name.startsWith('use') && name !== 'unknown') {\n      const exists = composables.some(c => c.name === name && c.source === source);\n      if (!exists) {\n        composables.push({ name, source, args: [] });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return composables;\n}",

          "body": "{\n  const functions: VueComponentAnalysis['functions'] = [];\n\n  if (!content || content.trim() === '') {\n    return functions;\n  }\n\n  // Парсим скрипт в AST\n  let ast: Program | null = null;\n  try {\n    ast = parseTS(content, {\n      ecmaVersion: 2022,\n      sourceType: 'module',\n      loc: true,\n      range: true,\n      ecmaFeatures: {\n        jsx: true,\n      },\n    }) as Program;\n  } catch {\n    // Если парсинг не удался, используем fallback через regex\n    return extractFunctionsFromScriptFallback(content);\n  }\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) {\n    return functions;\n  }\n\n  // Обходим AST для поиска функций\n  const visitNode = (node: any, parent?: any, _classContext?: string) => {\n    if (!node) return;\n\n    // 1. FunctionDeclaration\n    if (node.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' && node.id) {\n      const name = node.id.name;\n      if (name) {\n        const isExported = isNodeExported(node, parent);\n        const isAsync = node.async || false;\n        const params = node.params.map((p: any) => getParamName(p)).filter(Boolean);\n        const body = node.body ? extractBodyText(node.body) : '';\n        const line = node.loc?.start?.line || 1;\n\n        functions.push({\n          name,\n          line,\n          isAsync,\n          isExported,\n          params,\n          returnType: getReturnType(node),\n          body: body.length > 200 ? body.substring(0, 200) + '...' : body,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 2. ClassDeclaration - собираем методы\n    if (node.type === 'ClassDeclaration' && node.id) {\n      const className = node.id.name;\n      const isExported = isNodeExported(node, parent);\n\n      if (node.body?.body) {\n        for (const member of node.body.body) {\n          // Методы класса\n          if (member.type === 'MethodDefinition' && member.key) {\n            const methodName = member.key.name || member.key.value;\n            if (methodName && methodName !== 'constructor') {\n              const isAsync = member.value?.async || false;\n              const params = member.value?.params?.map((p: any) => getParamName(p)).filter(Boolean) || [];\n              const body = member.value?.body ? extractBodyText(member.value.body) : '';\n              const line = member.loc?.start?.line || 1;\n\n              // Проверяем, что метод не дублируется\n              if (!functions.find(f => f.name === `${className}.${methodName}`)) {\n                functions.push({\n                  name: `${className}.${methodName}`,\n                  line,\n                  isAsync,\n                  isExported,\n                  params,\n                  returnType: getReturnType(member.value),\n                  body: body.length > 200 ? body.substring(0, 200) + '...' : body,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          }\n\n          // Геттеры и сеттеры\n          if (member.type === 'PropertyDefinition' && member.key) {\n            const propName = member.key.name || member.key.value;\n            if (propName && member.value?.type === 'FunctionExpression') {\n              const isAsync = member.value.async || false;\n              const params = member.value.params?.map((p: any) => getParamName(p)).filter(Boolean) || [];\n              const body = member.value.body ? extractBodyText(member.value.body) : '';\n              const line = member.loc?.start?.line || 1;\n\n              if (!functions.find(f => f.name === `${className}.${propName}`)) {\n                functions.push({\n                  name: `${className}.${propName}`,\n                  line,\n                  isAsync,\n                  isExported,\n                  params,\n                  returnType: getReturnType(member.value),\n                  body: body.length > 200 ? body.substring(0, 200) + '...' : body,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 3. VariableDeclaration с стрелочными функциями\n    if (node.type === 'VariableDeclaration') {\n      const isExported = isNodeExported(node, parent);\n      const kind = node.kind;\n\n      for (const decl of node.declarations || []) {\n        if (decl?.id?.type === 'Identifier' && decl.init) {\n          const name = decl.id.name;\n          const isAsync = decl.init.async || false;\n          const isArrow = decl.init.type === 'ArrowFunctionExpression';\n          const isFunction = decl.init.type === 'FunctionExpression' || isArrow;\n\n          // ✅ ОБРАБОТКА СТРЕЛОЧНЫХ ФУНКЦИЙ В КОНСТАНТАХ\n          if (isFunction && name) {\n            const params = decl.init.params?.map((p: any) => getParamName(p)).filter(Boolean) || [];\n            const body = decl.init.body ? extractBodyText(decl.init.body) : '';\n            const line = decl.loc?.start?.line || 1;\n\n            // Пропускаем, если уже есть такая функция\n            if (!functions.find(f => f.name === name)) {\n              functions.push({\n                name,\n                line,\n                isAsync,\n                isExported: isExported || kind === 'const',\n                params,\n                returnType: getReturnType(decl.init),\n                body: body.length > 200 ? body.substring(0, 200) + '...' : body,\n              });\n            }\n          }\n\n          // Vue макросы\n          if (decl.init.type === 'CallExpression' && decl.init.callee?.type === 'Identifier') {\n            const macroName = decl.init.callee.name;\n            const vueMacros = ['defineProps', 'defineEmits', 'defineExpose', 'withDefaults'];\n            if (vueMacros.includes(macroName) && !functions.find(f => f.name === macroName)) {\n              const line = decl.loc?.start?.line || 1;\n              functions.push({\n                name: macroName,\n                line,\n                isAsync: false,\n                isExported: true,\n                params: [],\n                returnType: 'any',\n                body: `Vue macro: ${macroName}`,\n              });\n            }\n          }\n\n          // Composables\n          if CONST\n  const constRegex = /(?:^|\\n)\\s*const\\s+(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*([^;]+);/g;\n  while ((match = constRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {\n    const name = match[1];\n    const value = match[2]?.trim() || '';\n\n    if (name && !constants.find(c => c.name === name)) {\n      const isExported = content.includes(`export const ${name}`);\n      constants.push({\n        name,\n        value: value,\n        line: content.substring(0, match.index).split('\\n').length,\n        isExported,\n        type: 'const',\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 3. CONST с деструктуризацией массива\n  const destructureArrayRegex = /(?:export\\s+)?const\\s*\\[\\s*([^\\]]+)\\s*\\]\\s*=\\s*([^;]+);/g;\n  while ((match = destructureArrayRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {\n    const names = match[1]?.split(',').map(n => n.trim()).filter(n => n) || [];\n    const value = match[2]?.trim() || '';\n\n    for (const name of names) {\n      if (name && !constants.find(c => c.name === name)) {\n        const isExported = content.includes(`export const [${name}]`);\n        constants.push({\n          name,\n          value: value,\n          line: content.substring(0, match.index).split('\\n').length,\n          isExported,\n          type: 'const',\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 5. CONST с типом\n  const typedConstRegex = /(?:export\\s+)?const\\s+(\\w+)\\s*:\\s*[^=]+\\s*=\\s*([^;]+);/g;\n  while ((match = typedConstRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {\n    const name = match[1];\n    const value = match[2]?.trim() || '';\n\n    if (name && !constants.find(c => c.name === name)) {\n      const isExported = content.includes(`export const ${name}`);\n      constants.push({\n        name,\n        value: value,\n        line: content.substring(0, match.index).split('\\n').length,\n        isExported,\n        type: 'const',\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 6.           "body": "{\n  const variables: VueComponentAnalysis['variables'] = [];\n\n  if (!content || content.trim() === '') {\n    return variables;\n  }\n\n  // 1.           "body": "{\n  const interfaces: VueComponentAnalysis['interfaces'] = [];\n\n  if (!ast || !ast.body) return interfaces;\n\n  try {\n    for (const node of ast.body) {\n      const currentNode = node as any;\n\n      // TSInterfaceDeclaration\n      if (isTSInterfaceDeclaration(currentNode)) {\n        const typedNode = currentNode as any;\n        if (!typedNode.id) continue;\n\n        const name = typedNode.id.name;\n        const isExported = isNodeExported(currentNode);\n\n        const properties: string[] = [];\n        const extendsList: string[] = [];\n\n        // Извлекаем extends\n        if (typedNode.extends && Array.isArray(typedNode.extends)) {\n          for (const ext of typedNode.extends) {\n            const extNode = ext as any;\n            if (isTSExpressionWithTypeArguments(extNode) && extNode.expression) {\n              if (isIdentifier(extNode.expression)) {\n                extendsList.push(extNode.expression.name);\n              } else if (isTSQualifiedName(extNode.expression)) {\n                let parts: string[] = [];\n                let current = extNode.expression;\n                while (current && isTSQualifiedName(current)) {\n                  if (current.right && isIdentifier(current.right)) {\n                    parts.unshift(current.right.name);\n                  }\n                  current = current.left;\n                }\n                if (current && isIdentifier(current)) {\n                  parts.unshift(current.name);\n                }\n                extendsList.push(parts.join('.'));\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Извлекаем свойства\n        if (typedNode.body && typedNode.body.body && Array.isArray(typedNode.body.body)) {\n          for (const member of typedNode.body.body) {\n            const memberNode = member as any;\n\n            if (isTSPropertySignature(memberNode)) {\n              const key = getNodeKey(memberNode);\n              if (key && isIdentifier(key)) {\n                const propName = key.name;\n                if (propName) {\n                  properties.push(propName);\n                }\n              } else if (key && isLiteral(key)) {\n                const propName = key.value;\n                if (propName !== undefined) {\n                  properties.push(String(propName));\n                }\n              }\n            } else if (isTSIndexSignature(memberNode)) {\n              properties.push('[index: string]');\n            } else if (isTSMethodSignature(memberNode)) {\n              const key = getNodeKey(memberNode);\n              if (key && isIdentifier(key)) {\n                properties.push(`${key.name}()`);\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        interfaces.push({\n          name,\n          properties,\n          line: currentNode.loc?.start?.line || 0,\n          isExported,\n          extends: extendsList.length > 0 ? extendsList : undefined,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // TSTypeAliasDeclaration (интерфейсоподобные типы)\n      if (isTSTypeAliasDeclaration(currentNode)) {\n        const typedNode = currentNode as any;\n        if (!typedNode.id) continue;\n\n        const name = typedNode.id.name;\n        const isExported = isNodeExported(currentNode);\n\n        // ОБЫЧНЫЕ ИНТЕРФЕЙСЫ: interface Name { ... }\n  // ==========================================\n  const interfaceRegex = /(?:export\\s+)?interface\\s+(\\w+)\\s*(?:extends\\s+([^{]+))?\\s*\\{([\\s\\S]*?)\\}/g;\n  let match;\n  while ((match = interfaceRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {\n    const name = match[1];\n    const extendsStr = match[2]?.trim() || '';\n    const body = match[3]?.trim() || '';\n\n    if (name) {\n      const isExported = content.includes(`export interface ${name}`);\n\n      // Фильтруем undefined значения\n      const properties: string[] = body\n        .split(';')\n        .map(line => line.trim())\n        .filter(line => line && line.length > 0)\n        .map(line => {\n          const propMatch = line.match(/^\\s*(\\w+)\\s*(?:\\?)?\\s*:/);\n          if (propMatch) return propMatch[1];\n          const methodMatch = line.match(/^\\s*(\\w+)\\s*\\(/);\n          if (methodMatch) return methodMatch[1] + '()';\n          const indexMatch = line.match(/^\\s*\\[\\s*\\w+\\s*:\\s*\\w+\\s*\\]\\s*:/);\n          if (indexMatch) return '[index: string]';\n          return line.split(':')[0]?.trim() || '';\n        })\n        .filter((prop): prop is string => prop !== undefined && prop !== '');\n\n      const extendsList = extendsStr ? extendsStr.split(',').map(e => e.trim()) : [];\n\n      interfaces.push({\n        name,\n        properties,\n        line: content.substring(0, match.index).split('\\n').length,\n        isExported,\n        extends: extendsList.length > 0 ? extendsList : undefined,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ==========================================\n  // 2. ИНТЕРФЕЙСЫ С READONLY СВОЙСТВАМИ\n  // ==========================================\n  const readonlyInterfaceRegex = /(?:export\\s+)?interface\\s+(\\w+)\\s*(?:extends\\s+([^{]+))?\\s*\\{([\\s\\S]*?)\\}/g;\n  while ((match = readonlyInterfaceRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {\n    const name = match[1];\n    const extendsStr = match[2]?.trim() || '';\n    const body = match[3]?.trim() || '';\n\n    if (name && !interfaces.find(i => i.name === name)) {\n      const isExported = content.includes(`export interface ${name}`);\n\n      const properties: string[] = body\n        .split(';')\n        .map(line => line.trim())\n        .filter(line => line && line.length > 0)\n        .map(line => {\n          // Обработка readonly свойств\n          const readonlyMatch = line.match(/readonly\\s+(\\w+)\\s*(?:\\?)?\\s*:/);\n          if (readonlyMatch) return `readonly ${readonlyMatch[1]}`;\n          const propMatch = line.match(/^\\s*(\\w+)\\s*(?:\\?)?\\s*:/);\n          if (propMatch) return propMatch[1];\n          const methodMatch = line.match(/^\\s*(\\w+)\\s*\\(/);\n          if (methodMatch) return methodMatch[1] + '()';\n          return line.split(':')[0]?.trim() || '';\n        })\n        .filter((prop): prop is string => prop !== undefined && prop !== '');\n\n      const extendsList = extendsStr ? extendsStr.split(',').map(e => e.trim()) : [];\n\n      interfaces.push({\n        name,\n        properties,\n        line: content.substring(0, match.index).split('\\n').length,\n        isExported,\n        extends: extendsList.length > 0 ? extendsList : undefined,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  return interfaces;\n}",

        {
          "name": "mergeCallGraphs",
          "line": 663,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "graphs"
          ],
          "returnType": "import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/src/core/CallGraphComparator\").CallGraph",
          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n  const merged: CallGraph = {\n    nodes: new Set(),\n    edges: [],\n    entryPoints: [],\n  };\n\n  for (const graph of graphs) {\n    for (const node of graph.nodes) {\n      merged.nodes.add(node);\n    }\n    for (const edge of graph.edges) {\n      // Проверяем дубликаты\n      const exists = merged.edges.some(\n        e => e.from === edge.from && e.to === edge.to && e.type === edge.type\n      );\n      if (!exists) {\n        merged.edges.push(edge);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Обновляем точки входа\n  const calledFunctions = new Set(merged.edges.map(e => e.to));\n  merged.entryPoints = Array.from(merged.nodes).filter(name => !calledFunctions.has(name));\n\n  return merged;\n}",
          "startLine": 663,
          "endLine": 690,
